Een dak boven het hoofd is een fundamentele behoefte. Onze klant wil die behoefte helpen vervullen door eenvoudige, betaalbare en duurzame bouw- en verbouwproducten aan te bieden. Dat doen ze al 4 generaties lang. Vanaf de eerste generatie tot nu, bleef deze fundamentele waarde altijd aan de basis voor het succes van onze klant. Een rechtstreeks en persoonlijk contact met onze klanten staat hierin altijd centraal.

Als KRAANBESTUURDER ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het lossen van grondstoffen die per binnenvaartschip worden aangevoerd.

  • Als kraanbestuurder sta je in voor het lossen van de grondstoffen die per binnenvaartschip worden aangevoerd.

jobs.title: HOOFDBOEKHOUDER

Van vaste waarde op de vele veemarkten tot rundvleesspecialist met een doorgedreven verticale integratie. Bij hen vertaalt 70 jaar ervaring zich in kwaliteit, zekerheid en verwerking op maat van elke individuele klant.

jobs.title: Junior Accountant / Redovisningsekonom
jobs.description:
About us

Areta Group is a growing Nordic corporate services firm supporting international companies, investors and professional clients with accounting, governance and corporate administration across the Nordic region.

We are building a lean, high-quality team and are now looking for a Junior Accountant / Redovisningsekonom to support our growing client portfolio.

The role

You will work across several companies and support a variety of accounting and administrative tasks for our international client entities.

The role will include day-to-day accounting work, client coordination and support with reporting, reconciliations, filings and year-end processes. As your experience grows, you will have the opportunity to take on broader and more complex assignments.

Main responsibilities

    Ongoing bookkeeping and accounting
    Accounts payable and accounts receivable
    Bank reconciliations and other account reconciliations
    Preparation of payment files and supporting documentation
    Supporting VAT, employer and other recurring reporting
    Supporting monthly and year-end closing
    Preparing accounting files and documentation for clients, auditors and other advisers
    Assisting with annual reports and tax-related work
    Supporting the setup of accounting and reporting for new client entities
    Maintaining accurate accounting records, client files and supporting documentation
    Collecting and coordinating information from clients and third parties
    Supporting invoicing, payment administration and other practical client-related tasks
    Assisting with other accounting and administrative assignments as needed

What we are looking for

You should have:

    Education in accounting, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
    Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken, are required
    Good general IT skills and confidence working with Excel
    Comfortable working in accounting systems such as Fortnox, Visma or similar
    Strong attention to detail and a structured way of working
    A client-first mindset and a professional, service-oriented approach
    Good communication skills and care in client relationships
    Ability to manage several tasks and work to deadlines
    Flexibility and willingness to learn as the role and company develop

Accounting experience is an advantage, but we are also open to candidates earlier in their career who have the right foundation and attitude.

Nice to have

    Experience working with international clients or companies
    Experience with listed companies
    Experience with monthly or annual closing
    Experience working with auditors
    Experience with more than one accounting or ERP system

What we offer

This is an opportunity to join a growing company and develop together with the business.

You will gain exposure to different clients, industries and types of accounting work, with room to broaden your experience over time.

Role details

    Employment: Permanent employment, with an initial probationary period
    Working time: 50–100%
    Location: Stockholm / hybrid
    You should be comfortable working both remotely and from the office
    Start date: By agreement

Application

Please send your CV and a short introduction to:

hr@areta-group.com

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the recruitment process may close once the right candidate has been found.

jobs.title: Ryhmäliikunnanohjaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)
jobs.description:
**Ryhmäliikunnan ohjaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)**

Etsimme MTC:lle innostavia ryhmäliikunnan ohjaajia, jotka osaa ohjata monipuolisia tunteja, esimerkiksi PUMP, RPV, kehonhuoltoa ja kuntopiirejä. Lisäksi haemme erityisesti myös Pilates ohjaajaa. Jos sinua kiinnostaa, voit halutessasi tehdä myös asiakaspalvelutunteja salillamme.

Valmennuskeskus MTC on matalan kynnyksen liikuntakeskus Lielahdessa, Tampereella. Meillä on lämminhenkinen ja yhteisöllinen meininki: asiakkaamme viihtyvät luonamme, ja moni tulee paikalle myös jutustelemaan, ei vain treenaamaan. Suurin osa asiakkaistamme on keski-ikäisiä ja eläkeikää lähestyviä naisia, joille tärkeintä on arjen toimintakyky ja hyvä olo. Meillä ei siis lasketa kaloreita eikä juosta maratoneja, vaan keskitytään kokonaisvaltaiseen hyvinvointiin ja mukavaan fiilikseen.

Työ koostuu ryhmäliikuntatuntien ohjaamisesta, ja jos kiinnostusta löytyy, mukaan on mahdollista ottaa myös asiakaspalvelua. Ryhmätunnit painottuvat iltapäiviin ja iltoihin, mutta tarjolla on myös aamupäivätunteja.

**Työn alkaminen:** Työ alkaa joustavasti syksyn aikana sopimuksen mukaan.

**Työn muoto:** Alkuvaiheessa työtä tehdään yrittäjänä tai kevytyrittäjänä laskuttaen.

Jos osaat innostaa ryhmää liikkumaan ja haluat olla osa lämminhenkistä ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä, ota yhteyttä ja kerro itsestäsi!

AMI cherche un.e nouvel.le ambassadeur.drice BARISTA pour rejoindre notre Flagship du Marais.

Chez AMI, nous avons à cœur de créer une expérience client à la fois chaleureuse, authentique et exigeante, à l’image de notre Maison.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

 

Accueil et relation client

Gestion du matériel

  • Nettoyage quotidien et hebdomadaire des machines, du moulin et de l'ensemble du poste

  • Planification et suivi des maintenances préventives, gestion de la relation avec les techniciens

  • Détection et signalement des dysfonctionnements, gestion des interventions curatives

  • Respect et suivi des règles d'hygiène applicables au poste

Encadrement

  • Expérience confirmée en tant que barista en coffee shop de spécialité (2 à 3 ans minimum)

    -Maîtrise technique : réglages, extraction, latte art

  • Vous êtes curieux.se et avez envie de vous investir dans un tout nouveau projet.

  • La pratique de l'anglais est indispensable.

  • Date de démarrage : 15 novembre.

Why join the « F.ami.LY »?

Ami Paris se distingue par la sincérité de son expression. Nous réunissons des personnes passionnées et motivées, qui travaillent avec cœur et une énergie positive dans un cadre respectueux. Chaque membre de l’équipe contribue à créer un environnement dynamique, ou créativité et engagement vont de pair.

Nous recherchons des personnalités qui savent créer du lien, prendre des initiatives et faire preuve d’implication. Chez Ami, la qualité de l’expérience client repose autant sur le savoir-faire que sur le savoir-être : confiance, optimisme, créativité, engagement et esprit d’équipe.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.


So arbeiten wir

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht.
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen.

  • Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern

  • Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite.

  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap.

  • Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.

  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.title: Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible.
 

Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep.
That's your world.
As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer: 

  • great freedom for your creative ideas.
  • ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment.
  • Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design.
  • support with your relocation
  • a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side.
  • 30-day vacation by default.
  • an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day.
  • attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program.
  • unforgettable moments at our company events and team events.


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by phone +49 89 2441067714.

jobs.title: Er du vår nye superhelt medarbeider? 30-40% stilling
jobs.description:
Åpnet annonsen på Finn.no? For den beste leseropplevelsen anbefaler vi at du åpner annonsen i vårt rekrutteringssystem Teamtailor, ved å trykke "Søk her" til høyre for, eller i bunnen av Finn-annonsen.

Elsker du å jobbe tett med andre, og motiveres du av å skape resultater i team? I Big Bite er vi like opptatt av menneskene på begge sidene av disken, og vi definerer oss selv som Superhelter for sultne folk i farta!

Er du vår nye superhelt på Big Bite Tillertorget? Vi ser etter en fast 30-40% med mulighet for ekstra jobb i perioder. Arbeidstid vil være dag, kveld og helg.

Ikke alle helter har kappe. Noen har caps med logo på. Og nå jakter vi den rette medarbeider som kan jobbe både dag, kveld og helg. Du skal ikke bare temme sult og slukke tørst, men også spre hverdagsglede. 💥 

Med Big Bite får du sjanse til å være med på en lærerik reise i et helnorsk fastfood-konsept som tilbyr rask og rimelig mat i farta, med nysmurte subs som hovedprodukt. 🌯

Veteran eller ungt heltetalent?
Rett mentale innstilling veier vel så tungt som en CV med erfaring. Du vil fort se at Big Bite-systemet ikke holder kunnskapen innelåst. Tvert om, vi deler. Her bygger veteraner opp ferskinger. 

I tillegg kan du skilte med andre superkrefter, som at du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt og fremoverlent

  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo

  • Har et øye for salg

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK og står sterkt hos oss. Vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.

  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.

  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.

  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?
Vi tilbyr grundig opplæring og en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger. I fellesskap jobber vi for gode kundeopplevelser, likeså viktig er det at vi tar vare på hverandre i Big Bite-familien. 🥳 

Blir du trigget av dette håper vi å høre fra deg! 

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Big Bite. 

For ytterligere informasjon ta gjerne kontakt med franshisetaker Anne på tlf: 41340089

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Big Bite åpnet sin første avdeling i Trondheim i 1997 med en ambisjon om å lage rask og smakfull mat til folk i farta. I dag finnes Big Bite i hjertet av over 70 kjøpesenter og handlegater over hele Norge. Vi er en sterk nasjonal merkevare i vekst. Idéen er enkel, men supergod. Subs laget av ferske baguetter fra lokal baker, friske salater og lune wraps - servert innen sekunder med et smil på kjøpet.

jobs.title: Sähköasentaja konevuokraamoon Ouluun
jobs.description:
Sähköasentaja konevuokraamoon Ouluun

Etsimme sähköasentajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen tehtävään Oulussa toimivaan konevuokraamoon. Tarjolla on monipuolinen työ, jossa pääset vastaamaan monipuolisesti työmaan ja vuokrattavan kaluston sähköistyksestä.

Sähköasentajana vastaat työmaiden sähköistysratkaisujen toteuttamisesta sekä työmaapääkeskusten asennus-, käyttöönotto- ja ylläpitotöistä. Tehtävä sisältää monipuolisesti sähköasennuksia, kytkentöjä, palautustarkastuksia sekä sähköjärjestelmien huolto-, korjaus- ja muutostöitä. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluu myös vikojen selvittäminen ja tarvittavien korjaustoimenpiteiden toteuttaminen. Työ suoritetaan pääosin asiakkaan toimipisteellä Oulussa, mutta tehtävänkuvaan kuuluu myös säännöllinen käynti työmaakohteissa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Olet etsimämme henkilö, mikäli sinulla on sähköalan koulutus, voimassa oleva S2-pätevyys sekä kokemusta vahvavirtapuolen sähköasennuksista. Aiempi tausta toimitila- tai talosähköpuolen asennuksista antaa sinulle erinomaiset valmiudet tehtävässä menestymiseen

Työskentelet mielelläsi sekä itsenäisesti että osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Tartut toimeen oma-aloitteisesti, kannat vastuuta työstäsi ja pidät laadukkaasta työnjäljestä. Arvostamme huolellisuutta, yhteistyökykyä sekä halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi jatkuvasti. Tehtävässä vaaditaan voimassa olevia sähkötyöturvallisuus- ja työturvallisuuskortteja sekä B-ajokorttia.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
Tarjoamme sinulle pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden vakaassa yrityksessä, jossa osaamista arvostetaan ja työntekijöistä pidetään huolta. Saat monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään nykyistä osaamistasi ja kasvattamaan ammattitaitoasi edelleen. Ympärilläsi on kannustava työyhteisö sekä kokenut joukko ammattilaisia, jotka tukevat sinua työssäsi. Käytössäsi ovat laadukkaat työvälineet ja työvarusteet, jotka mahdollistavat sujuvan työskentelyn arjessa.

Työaika ja palkkaus
Työtä tehdään arkisin päivävuorossa. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Palkka määräytyy osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella. Tehtävässä on kiinteä kuukausipalkka.

Kiinnostuitko?
Klikkaa hakulinkkiä ja kirjaudu Eezy Osaajat -palveluun tai rekisteröidy uutena käyttäjänä. Täytä hakemus tehtävään ja lisää CV – järjestelmä poimii työkokemuksesi automaattisesti profiilillesi.

Voit myös kirjoittaa lyhyen esittelyn itsestäsi, esimerkiksi nykyisestä tilanteestasi, osaamisestasi ja siitä, millainen tekijä olet. Huolellisesti täytetty profiili helpottaa työnhakua myös tulevaisuudessa, sillä samalla
profiililla voit hakea kaikkiin Eezyn avoimiin työpaikkoihin.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

  • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

Who We're Looking For

Your Background

  • Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

What You'll Work On

  • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

  • Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

  • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

  • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

  • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

  • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

  • Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

Who We're Looking For

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

Your Background

  • 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.

  • Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.

  • Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.

  • Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted.

  • Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it.

  • Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware.

Nice to Have

jobs.title: Outreach: hulpverlening vanop de straat
jobs.description:
First things first: een kop koffie en een babbel met de collega’s. Je agenda toont een gevulde dag! Fijn, daar hou je van!



6u30: je hebt afgesproken met een collega om een ochtend te doen. Er zijn een aantal meldingen binnen gekomen via mail, o.a. via de politie en de stad, dat er dakloze cliënten liggen slapen op Astidplein -1 en in het stadspark. Je smeert wat broodjes en maakt koffie om mee te nemen tijdens de ronde. Je maakt contact met verschillende mensen en nodigt een aantal van hen uit op de permanentie voor verdere hulp.

9u: je hebt permanentie met een collega en opent dus om 9u00 de deur om de eerst cliënten die staan te wachten binnen te laten. Je biedt hen een koffie aan en nodigt hem/haar uit om plaats te nemen en zijn situatie uit te leggen. Een vrouw vertelt dat ze alles kwijt is geraakt nadat ze enkele maanden geleden uit haar woonst werd gezet. Sindsdien is ze dakloos en verblijft afwisselend op straat en bij een vriend. Ze kampt met een verslaving en heel wat psychische problemen. Het klinkt alsof de vriend misbruik van haar maakt. Intussen is ze ambtelijk geschrapt en heeft ze geen inkomen meer. Je regelt alvast een bed in de nachtopvang en bespreekt de situatie op de volgende teamvergadering om na te gaan wie ruimte heeft om deze dame verder te helpen. Je hebt haar nummer om terug te bellen om een nieuwe afspraak te maken.

10u: Je hebt even tijd om nog een dossier aan te vullen en enkele telefoons te doen, je typt ook een verslag in Myneva over de ochtendronde. Even later belt er opnieuw iemand aan met een hulpvraag. Je vraagt even te wachten zodat je uw telefoons verder kunt afhandelen om vervolgens opnieuw het gesprek aan te gaan met de nieuwe cliënt. Deze blijkt net in Antwerpen te zijn aangekomen, geen geldige verblijfspapieren te hebben noch een verblijfplaats. Normaal komt hij niet in aanmerking voor opvang in Victor 5 (nachtopvang in de winterperiode voor mensen zonder geldig verblijf) maar het vriest stevig buiten dus neem je contact op en regel je toch een bed voor de nacht. Je geeft ook nog wat adressen mee van de inloopcentra waar hij overdag terecht kan. Er komt ook nog een gekende cliënt langs die nog een vraag heeft over zijn centen, de bewindvoerder heeft niets gestort en hij vraagt te mogen bellen....

12u: je sluit de permanentie af, ruimt alles op en zet de gebruikte tassen in de afwasmachine in de keuken. Nadien is het tijd voor een welverdiende lunchpauze!



13u15: Je hebt afgesproken met een cliënt op bureau om nog samen een aanmeldformulier in te vullen voor Tijdelijk Wonen.

14u: je passeert nog even langs de daginloop om een cliënte te zoeken die eerder niet is opgedaagd. Je ging met haar normaal samen naar een consultatie in het ziekenhuis, maar ze blijkt niet aanwezig. Je wordt aangesproken door een andere cliënt met een vraag over een dagvaarding die hij heeft ontvangen. Je maakt even tijd voor een babbel en nodigt hem uit op de eerstvolgende permanentie.

14u30: je bent vandaag vroeg opgestaan dus mag je ook wat vroeger naar huis, je springt op je fiets en fietst huiswaarts.

-
je gaat in op directe vragen en noden, je bent geduldig en geeft niet op wanneer de cliënt niet direct aanhaakt.

-
Je zoekt naar creatieve oplossingen met betrekking tot persoonlijk welzijn en huisvesting op korte en langer termijn. Je stelt je erg flexibel op.

-
Je basishouding is onbevooroordeeld, je staat dicht bij de cliënt maar kan ook duidelijk grenzen aangeven waar nodig.

-
Je kent de betekenis van de termen als presentie, aanklampende zorg en bemoeizorg en hebt zin om deze methodieken in te zetten in je contacten met dak- en thuislozen

-

jobs.title: Fysioterapeut som utvecklar vår rehabilitering från sjukvård till friskvård
jobs.description:
Vill du kombinera fysioterapi och personlig träning med möjligheten att utveckla en verksamhet? Hos People’s Training i Nya Hovås söker vi en legitimerad fysioterapeut som vill hjälpa människor genom rehabiliteringen och vidare till en långsiktigt hållbar träning.

Du får en roll med tre tydliga delar:

    Utveckla vår försäkringsfinansierade fysioterapi – ansvara för och administrera våra avtal med försäkringsbolagen, utveckla patientinflödet och behandla försäkringspatienter.
    Arbeta inom vår regionfinansierade etablering – bidra med kliniskt arbete, inom ramen för samverkansavtalet med Västra Götalandsregionen.
    Bygga en egen kundbas inom personlig träning – aktivt hjälpa patienter att ta nästa steg från rehabilitering till fortsatt träning, utifrån deras behov, mål och eget val.

Tillsammans skapar dessa delar det som är en av våra främsta styrkor: en brygga från sjukvård till friskvård. Hos oss kan relationen och vägledningen fortsätta när patienten blir en tränande kund, med stöd att utvecklas och skapa hållbara vanor över tid.

Om People’s Training

People’s Training i Nya Hovås är en personlig tränings- och hälsomiljö där fysioterapeuter, personliga tränare och andra specialister arbetar tillsammans.

Vi tror på att förstå människan framför oss, möta henne där hon befinner sig och erbjuda rätt hjälp över tid. Lyhördhet, kompetens och nära samarbete är grunden i vårt arbete. Här delar vi kunskap, lär av varandra och tar vara på teamets olika kompetenser för att hjälpa våra patienter, kunder och medlemmar.

1. Utveckla och administrera våra försäkringsavtal

Du får ett tydligt ansvar för att förvalta våra befintliga avtal med försäkringsbolag och vårdförmedlare samt utveckla denna del av verksamheten. Det innebär att du:

    Håller ordning på avtal, ersättningsnivåer, villkor och kontaktvägar.
    Samordnar bokningar och följer upp att vi möter avtalade krav på tillgänglighet.
    Säkerställer fungerande rutiner för rapportering, fakturaunderlag och uppföljning.
    Utvecklar relationerna med befintliga avtalsparter och tar initiativ till nya kontakter och avtal.
    Följer upp patientinflöde och beläggning samt driver förbättringar tillsammans med ledningen.

Du behandlar också försäkringspatienter och får därmed en nära förståelse för både patienternas och avtalsparternas behov.

2. Fysioterapi inom vår regionfinansierade etablering

Du bedömer, behandlar och följer upp patienter, framför allt med besvär i rörelseapparaten. Träning och aktiv rehabilitering är viktiga delar av ditt arbetssätt.

Du bidrar till att utveckla patientflödena inom den fysioterapiverksamhet som bedrivs genom samverkansavtal med Västra Götalandsregionen. Tillsammans med teamet arbetar du för god tillgänglighet, kontinuitet och ett väl fungerande nyttjande av behandlingskapaciteten inom avtalets ramar.

3. Bygga bryggan från patient till tränande kund

Personlig träning är en uttalad och långsiktig del av tjänsten. Du vill själv coacha kunder och aktivt bygga en egen PT-kundbas.

När patienten är redo för nästa steg tar du initiativ till samtal om fortsatt träning. Du presenterar ett individuellt upplägg, erbjuder personlig coachning och följer upp intresset. Övergången bygger på personens behov, mål och eget val, med en tydlig skillnad mellan vård och privatbetald träning.

Som både fysioterapeut och personlig tränare kan du följa individen från rehabilitering till ökad självständighet, nya träningsmål och hållbara vanor. Den relation och tillit som byggts under rehabiliteringen blir en värdefull grund för fortsatt träning.

Du utvecklar även din PT-kundbas genom relationer med våra medlemmar, samarbete med kollegor och egna initiativ.

Vi söker dig som

    Har svensk legitimation som fysioterapeut eller sjukgymnast.
    Är trygg i självständiga bedömningar, behandling och rehabiliteringsplanering.
    Har god kunskap inom styrketräning och individanpassad träningsplanering.
    Vill arbeta aktivt med personlig träning och bygga en egen kundbas.
    Är strukturerad, van vid digitala system och tar ansvar för administrativa uppgifter.
    Trivs med att skapa kontakter, utveckla relationer och följa upp resultat genom tydliga nyckeltal.
    Kommunicerar väl på svenska i tal och skrift, både med patienter och i dokumentation.

Erfarenhet av försäkringspatienter, avtalsadministration, personlig träning eller arbete inom LOF/nationella taxan är meriterande. Även vidareutbildning inom exempelvis idrottsmedicin, smärta eller motiverande samtal är värdefull.

Du är en lyhörd och nyfiken kollega som gärna delar med dig av din kunskap och tar vara på andras kompetens. Du uppskattar att kombinera patientarbete med struktur och utveckling och vill bidra till att både människorna du hjälper och verksamheten utvecklas.

Hos oss får du

    Arbeta i en välutrustad studio med behandlingsrum, träningsytor och vår digitala gym (EGYM).
    Bli en del av ett team där samarbete och kunskapsutbyte är centralt.
    Kombinera kliniskt arbete med personlig träning och verksamhetsutveckling.
    Möjlighet att påverka hur fysioterapin och övergången till fortsatt träning utvecklas.

jobs.title: Material Technology Engineer – Comfort
jobs.description:
Company Description

Help create the next generation of comfort solutions

Are you passionate about textiles, comfort, and material innovation? Do you want to influence how millions of people experience comfort in their everyday life?

We're looking for a Material Technology Engineer - Comfort to drive the development of innovative materials, technologies, and manufacturing solutions within our Textile & Comfort area. You will combine deep material expertise with a strong understanding of customer needs, sustainability, and industrial production to create better products at an affordable price. Based on the responsibilities and competence requirements described for the Material Technology Engineer role.

Job Description

Your mission

As part of the Material & Engineering team, you will lead innovation and development projects focused on textiles, soft materials, comfort constructions, and related manufacturing technologies.

You will work closely with product developers, suppliers, innovation teams, and external partners to identify opportunities and transform ideas into scalable solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Leading material and technology development projects within textile and comfort categories.
    Exploring new textile materials, fibers, constructions, fillings, foams, nonwovens, and comfort solutions.
    Evaluating emerging technologies and their potential application in future products.
    Supporting material roadmaps and identifying innovation opportunities that contribute to quality, sustainability, affordability, and customer value.
    Working early in the product development process to ensure optimal material and comfort solutions.
    Collaborating with suppliers, universities, startups, and industry experts to bring external innovation into the business.
    Developing and maintaining material specifications, quality requirements, and technical documentation.
    Driving knowledge sharing and capability building within Textile & Comfort.
    Supporting the implementation of new materials and technologies in industrial production.

Qualifications

Who you are

You are curious by nature and genuinely excited about understanding how materials influence comfort, functionality, durability, and sustainability.

We believe you have:

    A degree in Textile Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
    Experience working with textiles, soft materials, comfort products, upholstery, mattresses, bedding, furniture, automotive interiors, or related industries.
    Strong knowledge of textile materials, fiber technologies, fabric constructions, nonwovens, foams, fillings, or comfort systems.
    Experience leading development projects and working cross-functionally in complex environments.
    The ability to translate customer needs into material and technology solutions.
    A strong interest in sustainability, circularity, recycled materials, and future material innovations.
    Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
    Strong communication skills in English.

We think you'll thrive if you are

    Passionate about textiles and comfort.
    Curious about future materials and emerging technologies.
    Able to combine technical depth with commercial understanding.
    Analytical and comfortable working with both data and hands-on testing.
    Energised by collaboration across functions, cultures, and external networks.
    Motivated by creating products that improve everyday life for the many people.

Additional Information

Why this role?

This is an opportunity to shape the future of comfort. You will work with material innovation from idea to implementation, influencing everything from next-generation textile materials to sustainable comfort solutions that reach customers around the world.

If you are excited about combining material science, textile expertise, innovation, and customer insight, we would love to hear from you.

Please see we will have this position open on several locations ( Älmhult, Warsaw, Shanghai and Ho Chi Minh City), it is however same position that we are looking for to be placed in one of these locations.

Apply now and help us create better comfort through better materials. Please send us your application – CV and letter of motivation – in English latest by 13 October 2026.

We wish for you to answer the following question:

    How do you see you could contribute as an MTE to the Textile and Comfort material innovation?

If you have questions about the role, please contact Material & Engineering Manager Catarina Englund at catarina.englund1@inter.ikea.com

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact People & Culture Specialist Femina Karlsson at femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organizational changes provided competence requirements are met for the role.  

Welcome with your application!

jobs.title: ICEHOTEL - Chef
jobs.description:
A hotel built from snow and ice sourced from the Torne River, featuring art created by selected artists who travel here from across the globe. Our operations include traditional hotel rooms and cabins, Icehotel 365 – a hotel by night and an art gallery by day and, from mid-December to mid-April, our seasonal winter hotel made entirely of snow and ice.

We are passionate about creating enriching experiences and living in harmony with nature. In addition to the ice art, we offer nature-based activities and culinary experiences, both in-house and in collaboration with carefully selected partners, as a complement to the art.

About the Role

Join to our Breakfast and Lunch team, and create a memorable Swedish Arctic Breakfast experience to our guests through a buffet or a la carte service.

As a chef at ICEHOTEL, you’ll be part of a creative and dynamic team that delivers high-quality food experiences in a truly unique environment. We operate three distinct restaurants:

    The Restaurant – our main venue, open year-round, serving breakfast, lunch buffets, à la carte dinners, group menus, and special dietary requests. It’s also the hub for preparing over 3,000 meals for our tours and activities.

    The Old Homestead – our cozy winter bistro located in a 400-year-old wooden house by the Torne River, known for its signature pizzas and charcoal-grilled dishes.

    The Veranda – our chef’s table and show-cooking experience, where storytelling and creativity take center stage. Currently open during the winter season only.

Each restaurant has its own character, all rooted in the identity of Swedish Lapland.

Responsibilities

    Preparing and cooking our Breakfast, buffet or a la carte in a high quality, in line with ICEHOTEL’s culinary concept.

    Collaborate with the kitchen team to ensure smooth daily operations.

    Maintain high standards of hygiene, safety, and food quality.

    Contribute to menu development and seasonal offerings.

    Support events such as weddings, conferences, and private dining experiences.

Who are you?

We’re looking for a team player with a passion for food and a willingness to grow. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy working with others to create memorable guest experiences.

Qualifications

    Previous experience in a professional kitchen is an advantage, but not a requirement – we value attitude and willingness to learn.

    Ability to work under pressure and adapt to seasonal changes.

    Good communication skills in English.

    A genuine interest in food, sustainability, and nature-based experiences.

About the position

    Type of employment: Full-time, part-time, or seasonal.

    Start date: As agreed.

    Location: Jukkasjärvi, Sweden.

    Staff accommodation is available if needed.

What we offer

    A unique workplace in one of the world’s most extraordinary environments.

    The opportunity to take part in activities such as snowmobile safaris under the northern lights or ski tours with Swedish fika.

    A supportive and inclusive team culture.

    Staff benefits and discounts.

    Accommodation options for employees.

Applications are only accepted through this application method. The position may be filled before the final application date, so don’t wait to apply. If you have any questions, feel free to contact diego@icehotel.com.

To be eligible for the position, you must be an EU citizen or have a valid work permit in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

LVI-asentajan tehtäviin kuuluvat LVI-järjestelmien vianetsintä, huolto, korjaukset ja asennustyöt vaihtuvissa asiakaskohteissa. Työssä tarvitaan itsenäistä työotetta, ongelmanratkaisutaitoja sekä kykyä arvioida tilanteita ja viedä työt huolellisesti loppuun. Työt tulee tehdä voimassa olevien LVI-alaa koskevien säännösten ja määräysten sekä valmistajien ohjeiden mukaisesti.

Tehtävässä edellytetään hitsaus- ja juotostaitoa, myös kaasulla sekä esimerkiksi vesikalusteiden, elektronisten hanojen ja suihkujen asennus- ja korjaustaitoa. Työhön kuuluu myös piirustusten ja asennusohjeiden lukemista, älypuhelimen ja työssä käytettävien sovellusten käyttöä sekä työn dokumentointia.

Asentajalta odotetaan hyvää asiakaspalveluasennetta, yhteistyökykyä sekä siistiä ja työturvallista työskentelyä. Tehtävään kuuluu myös päivystysvuoroja.

**Odotamme sinulta**

- hitsaus- ja juotostaitoa, erityisesti kaasuhitsaustaitoa

jobs.title: Enhetsleder døgnavdeling
jobs.description:
Vil du lede og videreutvikle et spesialisert behandlingstilbud for mennesker med alvorlige psykiske lidelser? 

Vi søker en engasjert og tydelig enhetsleder til vår Rehabilitering/psykose døgnavdeling ved Solli DPS. Døgnavdelingen har 10 døgnplasser og består av et kompetent fagmiljø som tilbyr døgnbehandling til pasienter med alvorlige og sammensatte psykiske lidelser, med hovedvekt på psykoseproblematikk.  

Enhetsleder har ansvar for drift og personal i en avdeling med høy aktivitet og komplekse problemstillinger, og har i tillegg en nøkkelrolle i videreutviklingen av behandlingstilbudet og fagmiljøet. Vi søker en leder som ønsker å skape gode rammer for pasientbehandling, og samtidig bidra til utvikling av både den enkelte medarbeider, enheten og virksomheten som helhet.  Vi er spesielt opptatt av å styrke og utvikle det miljøterapeutiske arbeidet, og har et spesifikt fokus på mentaliseringsbasert miljøterapi. 

Rehab/psykose døgn er en del av Seksjon for døgnbehandling og rehabilitering, sammen med allmenn døgnavdeling og FACT-/psykosepoliklinikk. Enhetene samarbeider tett om pasientforløp, personal, fagutvikling og kompetansebygging, og seksjonen kjennetegnes av et sterkt faglig fellesskap og et felles ønske om å utvikle gode tjenester for pasientene våre. 

Solli DPS arbeider kontinuerlig med faglig utvikling, forskning og innovasjon. Vi har flere pågående forskningsprosjekter, utviklingsarbeid innen digitale behandlingsløsninger og et tydelig fokus på kvalitet, pasientsikkerhet og kontinuerlig forbedring. jobs.title: Er du vår nye pedagogiske leder? Bli med på laget i Ankerhagen barnehage!
jobs.description:
Ankerhagen barnehage SA er en foreldreeid barnehage med et varmt og profesjonelt arbeidsmiljø, der relasjoner, samarbeid og trygghet står sterkt. Vi er en barnehage som vil noe, og som har satt tydelig kurs i årsplanen vår: mer prosessorientert arbeid, systematiske observasjoner, refleksjon som drivkraft og rommet som aktiv medspiller i barnas hverdag.

Vi er midt i et spennende utviklingsarbeid hvor målet er å endre vår pedagogiske arbeidsmåte til å bli mindre tradisjonell og mer prosessorientert. Vi har et fagmiljø som er motivert for å bevege seg i samme retning. Her vil du komme inn i et miljø som er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og faglig ambisiøst, og som tør å gjøre små og målrettede justeringer i hverdagen.

Vi søker en pedagogisk leder i fast stilling som ønsker å bidra i dette arbeidet – en som vil bruke sin kompetanse, nysgjerrighet og trygghet til å styrke det vi allerede har, og være med på å videreutvikle praksisen vår. Stillingen er på småbarnsavdeling med 8 barn i alderen 1 år.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ønsker oss en person som:

  • Er varm, tilstedeværende og bygger gode relasjoner til barn, foreldre og kollegaer

  • Har et oppriktig engasjement for barns lek, utvikling og læring

  • Er faglig nysgjerrig og liker å reflektere over egen praksis

  • Tar initiativ og ønsker å bidra til utvikling og endring

  • Er trygg på å lede, veilede og samarbeide med medarbeidere

  • Ser verdien av godt samarbeid og bidrar til et positivt arbeidsmiljø

  • Har evne til å skape struktur og oversikt i en innholdsrik arbeidshverdag

  • Er åpen for nye perspektiver og ønsker å lære sammen med andre

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du liker å stille spørsmål, utforske muligheter og utvikle praksis i fellesskap. Du trenger ikke å ha alle svarene, men vi ønsker oss en pedagogisk leder som har lyst til å være med på å finne dem sammen med oss.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Lede, planlegge, gjennomføre, dokumentere og vurdere det pedagogiske arbeidet på avdelingen

  • Skape et trygt, inkluderende og utviklende miljø for barn og voksne

  • Ivareta barns medvirkning og legge til rette for lek, læring og gode relasjoner

  • Bruke observasjon, dokumentasjon og refleksjon aktivt for å utvikle praksis

  • Bidra til å videreutvikle det prosessorienterte arbeidet i tråd med barnehagens årsplan

  • Være en tydelig og relasjonell leder som ser, støtter og utvikler medarbeiderne

  • Veilede og følge opp personalet i det daglige pedagogiske arbeidet

  • Bidra aktivt i pedagogisk utviklingsarbeid og lærende møter

  • Samarbeide godt med foreldre, kollegaer og eksterne samarbeidspartnere

  • Delta i barnehagens lederteam og bidra til helhet og kvalitet på tvers av avdelingene

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss får du:

  • Et varmt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • Et faglig engasjert og samarbeidsorientert personal

  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling og medvirkning

  • En arbeidsplass preget av humor, glede og stor takhøyde

  • Mulighet til å påvirke og videreutvikle barnehagens pedagogiske praksis

  • Deltakelse i et spennende faglig nettverk gjennom Rommets kraft. Et læringsnettverk der vi henter inspirasjon, dele erfaringer og utvikler vår forståelse av hvordan det fysiske miljøet påvirker barns lek, læring og trivsel)

  • Ansatte som videreutdanner seg og henter inspirasjon fra ny forskning

  • Vi har stengt i julen, påsken og 3 uker i juli

Lønnstrinn 32-45, 614 600-767 500

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ankerhagen barnehage er en foreldreeid barnehage. Vi befinner oss i en grønn oase et steinkast fra Aker brygge.

Barnehagen består av 3 avdelinger: Månestråle med 8 barn 1-år, Solglimt 12 barn 1-2 år og Regnbuen 19 barn 3-6 år.

Hos oss møter du en personalgruppe på 12 ansatte, hvor noen har lang erfaring fra Ankerhagen, mens andre er nyere i fellesskapet.

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
About Flink

Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics.

We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it.

The role

You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome.

What you'll do

  • Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent.

  • Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed.

  • Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do.

  • Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels.

  • Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class.

  • Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable.

  • Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe.

  • Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink.

  • Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it.

What you bring

  • A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great.

  • Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things

  • Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media

  • A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count

  • Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build

  • First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count)

Nice to have

  • German (spoken or written)

  • Photo or video shooting and editing skills

  • Experience with website design

  • Interior design, set design or event production experience

  • Previous startup or tech-company experience

What we offer

  • The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise

  • Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one

  • Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world

  • A growing, ambitious team in Zürich

  • Competitive salary and employee stock options

  • Budget and freedom to try new ideas

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Overview

Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence.

At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence.

We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us.

The Role

You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role.

This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone.

What You Will Do

  • Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships.

  • Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps.

  • Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

  • Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is.

  • Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks.

  • Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes.

  • Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination.

Who You Are

  • A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle.

  • Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched.

  • Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers.

  • A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity.

  • High ownership and bias toward action.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others.

  • Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out.

  • Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck.

  • A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too: Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering.

  • Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience.

Requirements

  • Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate.

  • Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia.

  • Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles.

  • Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred.

At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change.

We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence.

With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success.

jobs.title: Blir du med på bowling, gaming eller bare en rolig dag?
jobs.description:
Dette er meg

Hei! Jeg er 19 år og har nylig flyttet hjemmefra. Jeg trives veldig godt med å ha mitt eget sted og friheten som følger med det. Det jeg liker å holde på med er gaming, skating og å spille gitar - så det er stort sett en av de tre tingene du finner meg opptatt med.

Nå ser jeg etter en assistent som kan bli med meg på aktiviteter og finne på ting sammen med meg. Det kan være bowling, svømming, klatring, biljard, en tur ut eller noe helt annet vi kommer på. Du må gjerne komme med forslag også - det er jo litt av poenget at vi kan finne på ting underveis.

Det viktigste er egentlig ganske enkelt: Vi må trives sammen.

Det er selvfølgelig fint om vi har noen av de samme interessene, men du trenger ikke å kunne diskutere gaming i timevis eller imponere meg på gitar. Personlighet og kjemi betyr mye mer.

Jeg trives best med folk som er rolige og trygge, og som ikke føler behov for å ta veldig mye plass. Noen dager har jeg lyst til å komme meg ut og gjøre noe. Andre dager vil jeg helst ta det rolig eller ha litt tid for meg selv. Det er derfor fint om du klarer å lese situasjonen og ikke tenker at stillhet nødvendigvis betyr at noe må fikses.

Du trenger ikke å ha jobbet som BPA tidligere. Du får opplæringen du trenger. Det jeg bryr meg mer om, er at du er til å stole på, møter opp som avtalt og er fleksibel når det trengs.

Jeg ser med andre ord ikke etter noen som skal «aktivisere meg». Jeg ser etter en assistent som gjør det enklere for meg å leve hverdagen og finne på de tingene jeg selv har lyst til.

Og hvis vi samtidig har det hyggelig sammen, er jo det ganske perfekt.

Det er en fordel om du har førerkort og egen bil som vi kan bruke når vi skal på aktiviteter. Du får selvfølgelig kilometergodtgjørelse.


Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid

Jeg søker i første omgang en fleksibel tilkallingsvikar som kan jobbe ved behov, og noen ganger også på relativt kort varsel. Til å begynne med ser jeg for meg rundt 2-3 timer i uken.

På sikt kan det bli mulighet for en fast stilling og flere timer.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Da håper jeg du sender inn en søknad og forteller litt om deg selv, hva du liker å gjøre og hvorfor du tror vi kan passe godt sammen.

Hvis du vil vite mer om stillingen, kan du kontakte Marita Thomassen på telefon 911 23 067.


Mye mer enn bare penger

Visste du at med erfaring fra jobben som personlig assistent er du ettertraktet også i andre jobber?

Når du jobber så tett på mennesker som assistenter gjør, får du en helt egen kunnskap om relasjonsbygging. Du får kunnskap og erfaringer som er unik og verdsatt i arbeidslivet! All arbeidserfaring er relevant for BPA assistenter. Vi mener at BPA ikke er en helsetjeneste, våre BPA-assistenter skal bidra til at våre vedtakseiere hver dag får en bedre hverdag!

Hva du får som assistent i BPA Nord:

  • Sikre deltids- og heltidsstillinger | Varierte arbeidstider
  • Kurs og god opplæring | Assistentmanual
  • Timelønn som ligger over gjennomsnittet i liknende jobber
  • Kompetanseutvikling via gratis E-læringskurs

As the Visual Merchandiser (VM) & Commercial Lead, you are the technical specialist ensuring that all commercial actions are optimized within the overall Brand direction and Sales market VM priorities, always securing an elevated, competitive and convenient customer experience within physical stores

You will:

WHO YOU ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.



JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Order Management Specialist / Customer Support Specialist for a company in Nyköping. Start is November 9th, 8 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Nyköping.



About the Assignment

We are looking for an experienced Order Management Specialist / Customer Support Specialist for a consulting assignment within a large international industrial and technology organization in Nyköping.

In this role, you will provide internal customer support and take ownership of customer-related cases throughout the order and logistics process. You will work in close collaboration with several internal functions to ensure efficient case handling, smooth order flows and a high level of customer satisfaction.

The position is initially on-site in Nyköping 100%, with the possibility of a hybrid setup at a later stage.

Your Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

    

Provide support related to orders, deliveries, payments and other customer-related matters

    

Manage and follow up orders and cases throughout the process

    

Work with SAP and logistics flows

    

Coordinate customer cases with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain Management and other relevant functions

    

Ensure ownership of cases from initial request through resolution

    

Coordinate with After-Sales Service and Spare Parts when required

    

Identify and resolve issues that may affect deliveries or customer satisfaction

    

Work with Microsoft 365 as part of your daily activities

Requirements

To be successful in this assignment, we believe that you have:

    

Previous experience in customer support, order management or a similar role

    

Experience working with SAP

    

Good understanding of order and logistics flows

    

Good knowledge of Microsoft 365

    

Strong communication and coordination skills

    

Ability to take ownership of cases and independently drive them toward resolution

    

Fluent communication skills in Swedish and English, both spoken and written

Personal Qualities

We are looking for someone who is structured, service-minded and solution-oriented. You enjoy working in a coordinating role with several internal stakeholders and are comfortable taking responsibility for ensuring that customer matters are handled efficiently and professionally.

You have a collaborative approach, communicate clearly and are motivated by providing high-quality support and creating smooth processes for both customers and internal teams.

This role requires fluency in Swedish and English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is November 9th, 8 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Nyköping.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician (Junior) – Full Training Provided
jobs.description:
Founded in 1948, our client is a Belgian family-owned company specializing in exterior joinery. The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. The company is known for its modern production facilities, continuous innovation and long-term investment in employee development.


Jobomschrijving

If you are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and looking to build your career in a modern manufacturing environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Our client is looking for Junior Maintenance Technicians / Electromechanics who have a technical education and are motivated to develop their skills through comprehensive on-the-job training.

Without reliable maintenance, there is no quality! As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the smooth operation of production by performing preventive maintenance, identifying technical issues, and supporting continuous improvements.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

We are primarily looking for candidates who:

  • Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).
  • Have a basic understanding of mechatronics, including fundamentals of PLC systems, sensors, actuators, electricity, mechanics and pneumatics.
  • Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.
  • Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.
  • Work accurately and pay attention to safety.
  • Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.
  • Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

You will join the Industrialization team, the group that turns ANYmal from something engineers can build into something a factory can build, test, and release at volume. When those tests are effective, quality issues are caught in Zurich before reaching a customer's industrial site. jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you're returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

Notabene is proud to be an equal employment workplace and an affirmative action employer. By valuing inclusion and diversity of all forms, we strictly prohibit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation.
