Som daglig leder får du ansvaret for den daglige drift af køkkenet, herunder sikring af høje standarder for fødevaresikkerhed, kvalitet, samt styring af arbejdsgange og teamet. Du trives i et dynamisk miljø og formår at bevare overblikket – også når der er hændt travlhed.


Vi søger dig, som:

  • Har solid erfaring med ledelse af et professionelt køkken.

  • Har et godt kendskab til driften, varebestilling, egenkontrol og mandskabsplanlægning.

  • Det er en kæmpe bonus, hvis du har dybdegående erfaring med og kendskab til det tyrkiske køkken og dets autentiske smage og traditioner.

  • Er struktureret, kvalitetsbevist og en god igangsætter, der går for aften som forrest.

Praktisk information

Arbejdstider: Ligger typisk alle ugens dage i tidsrummet kl. 10:00 – 20:00.

Løn: Fastsættes efter kvalifikationer.

jobs.title: EMEA Account Executive (German speaking)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: this role is based out of the EMEA territory, specifically London, UK.

Regional Expectations

  • Based in an EMEA time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus.

German Language Expectations

  • Native-level or full professional fluency in German (written and spoken), with the ability to conduct complex sales conversations and negotiations.

Opportunity

Deepgram is looking for an Account Executive to drive new customers and revenue to our rapidly growing company, specifically in the German markets. You will have the opportunity to sell a patented world-class voice AI platform that has been enabling our customers to achieve things previously not attainable. We are looking for hungry and talented sales professionals to help us take our top-line revenue to new heights!

What You'll Do

  • Self-prospecting to build a strong sales pipeline of new logos, striving to exceed quarterly and annual sales targets, as well as partnering with the Marketing and SDR teams to generate meetings

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (especially Sales Ops and Sales Engineers) to ensure sales effectiveness

  • Have a depth of understanding regarding customer needs in the voice AI space, competition, and Deepgram products to be able to articulate Deepgram’s value proposition fully to highly technical buyers

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, work with CSMs to drive upsell opportunities and manage existing accounts ongoing

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Value having leadership that has tenure and a track record of success

  • Thrive working with A Players as cross-functional partners across GTM

  • Understand the importance of selling a product that is market validated and can deliver on its technical promise

  • Believe there should be no cap to upside and want control of account up-sell potential

  • Are passionate about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • Proven experience in a technical full-cycle sales role

  • Experience building your own pipeline from scratch and closing accounts

  • Consistent overachievement against sales targets in past experiences

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Empathy and a unique ability to understand customer needs

  • Highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills due to managing multiple opportunities at any given time

  • Ability to drive a consistent and repeatable sales process with a coachable/adaptable mindset based on other rep success.

  • It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Familiarity with Challenger or Triangle sales methodology

  • Experience selling to a technical audience in a similar space

  • Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI/ML technologies.

  • Fluency in German, French, Dutch, or other major regional languages.

jobs.title: Experienced Data Engineer Consultant
jobs.description:
Experienced Data Engineer Consultant

  • Kampmannsgade 2, 1604 København, Denmark

  • Full-time

  • Contract type: Permanent contract

Job Description

Are you an experienced Data Engineer ready for your next challenge? Would you like to lead technical architecture, mentor junior talent, and work directly with clients while staying at the forefront of modern data technologies? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools. 

  • Contract: Full-time 

  • Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

Work Assignments

As an Experienced Data Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and business advisory. You will be responsible for:

  • Technical Design & Development: Designing and developing modern data solutions, ensuring our team implements the highest standards of data engineering.

  • Advisory & Collaboration: Acting as a trusted partner for our clients’ decision makers, ensuring good collaboration with their engineers, analysts, & business users.

  • Mentorship & Growth: Elevating our team of less experienced engineers through mentoring and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement.

You will collaborate with our experienced data engineers, while quickly taking a mentoring role for our many less experienced consultants. 

What You Bring to the Team

Ideally, you have:

  • Solid experience working as a Data Engineer. 

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or APIs. 

  • Previous experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

  • An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

  • Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

  • A relevant degree.

  • A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

  • Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies.

  • Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited unpaid time off.

  • Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year. Recently we have done Lasertag, Pottery, Disc Golf, Book Club, Curling, Board Game Night, Foosball Tournament, Ice Hockey, among many other things.

Our Impact

Below are a few examples of our work:

  • Migrated Novo's global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using dbt, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.

  • Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.

  • Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service framework to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

Application Process

Apply by uploading your CV no later than October 18th.

We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. 

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

Stock control and documentation - Maintain accurate records of machine locations, serial numbers, attachments and stock movements. - Coordinate physical stock checks and investigate discrepancies with the relevant teams. - Check incoming equipment against orders and record shortages, damage or specification differences. - Ensure each machine has the required documentation, including operating manuals, warranty information and relevant conformity documents. - Coordinate customs clearance and import/export paperwork with suppliers and appointed agents where required. - Support registration processes where applicable. jobs.description:

Company Profile & Job Overview: Elecnor Ireland Limited is currently seeking an experienced Wireman to join our project teams based in County Kerry and County Sligo. We are a leading provider of engineering and energy infrastructure, specializing in high-voltage substations and power distribution networks across Ireland. In this role, you will be responsible for executing essential electrical installation work for major infrastructure projects, ensuring high standards of technical precision and quality. Key Responsibilities: - Installation of comprehensive cable management systems, including cable trays, ladder racks, and protective trunking. - Pulling, routing, and securing heavy industrial power cables, auxiliary cabling, and control cables across substation sites. - Precise termination and glanding of Steel Wire Armoured (SWA) cables, flexible control cabling, and multi-core signal wiring. - Wiring, dressing, and organizing complex control panels, protection relays, marshalling kiosks, and local control cubicles. - Working directly from detailed electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring schedules, and technical termination drawings. - Conducting pre-commissioning checks, continuity testing, and verifying connections alongside site engineering teams. - Ensuring all installation work complies strictly with project specifications, engineering standards, and quality requirements. Key Requirements: - Solid experience as a Wireman or Industrial Electrician, ideally in High Voltage (HV) substations or industrial energy facilities. - Strong practical skills in heavy cable pulling, SWA glanding, cable management installation, and control panel wiring. - Ability to read and interpret complex electrical wiring diagrams, schematics, and schedules accurately. - High standard of workmanship, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively within a site team. Working Hours & Compensation: - Hours: Standard working week of 45 hours, Monday to Friday. - Salary: €40,000 to €45,000 per annum, depending on experience. - Benefits: 22 days of annual leave plus 10 public holidays, company-provided accommodation, and statutory pension contributions.

jobs.title: HR & Marketing Coordinator (m/w/d) – Remote CH
jobs.description:
What to expect

Are you an organizational talent with initial experience in HR and/or marketing, eager to help shape the intersection of people, marketing, and business development in an HR boutique? Are you tech-savvy, work quickly and precisely, and have a good eye for aesthetics, clear communication, and polished results?

Then you’re a fit for us. We’re not looking for a pure assistant who simply ticks off tasks, but an independent, versatile person who will further develop our external presence, support projects operationally, and relieve the team in day-to-day business—with high velocity, a strong quality mindset, and a genuine drive to contribute.


Your tasks and responsibilities

Marketing & Communication

  • You independently own our marketing channels: LinkedIn, newsletter, website, and online events—from concept and planning through content creation to operational execution
  • You create content for our B2B social media channels—professional, on-brand, and tailored to the target audience
  • You keep our website up to date, maintain content, optimize layout and formatting, and ensure a consistent, aesthetic appearance
  • You plan and organize online events, webinars, and partner events and support their operational delivery
  • You manage communication and coordination with our partners and external service providers

HR & Project Support
  • You support our consulting team on client projects: data analysis, data preparation, research, presentations, and documentation
  • You contribute to HR software implementations—e.g., data migration, test runs, configuration, and quality assurance
  • You support recruiting: candidate sourcing, applicant communication, scheduling, and ATS maintenance
  • You create professional project materials, reports, proposals, and presentations in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and other tools
  • You take on organizational and administrative tasks that relieve the team in day-to-day operations


Your profile


  • 2+ years of professional experience in HR, marketing, project management, or a comparable coordinating role—ideally in a start-up, consulting environment, or agency
  • University degree or completed vocational training in a relevant field
  • Highly tech-savvy: you quickly get up to speed with new tools, platforms, and systems and enjoy optimizing digital processes
  • You work at very high speed, have a quick grasp of new topics, and bring strong organizational talent and project management skills
  • You have a good eye for aesthetics, design, formatting, and spelling—your outputs look professional and are error-free
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint) and Google Workspace; you create visually appealing presentations and documents
  • You understand B2B social media and know how to create professional LinkedIn content that drives reach and relevance
  • Experience with content management systems, newsletter tools (e.g., Mailchimp, HubSpot), or comparable platforms
  • You work independently, reliably, and in a structured way—even when managing multiple tasks in parallel
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English; additional languages are a plus
  • Based in Switzerland with the appropriate residence and work permits


What we offer


  • Remote only: Work from wherever you’re most productive—on-site at the client only in exceptional cases; team events approx. once per quarter
  • Maximum flexibility: Part-time from 40% (16 hours/week) possible—you set your own working hours
  • Responsibility from day one: You are a core part of our team—no hierarchy, short decision paths
  • Variety: No two days are alike—you work at the intersection of marketing, HR, and project business and get to know the full spectrum of an HR boutique
  • Appreciation: We value you as a team member and as a person—trust, coaching, and honest feedback are part of our culture

jobs.title: Senior Automation & OT Engineer e/v/e/r/y/o/n/e

Your mission

We are looking for a Senior Automation & OT Engineer to develop our automation strategy while ensuring the day-to-day reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement of the operational technology running our production equipment. Sitting at the intersection of automation engineering and IT operations, you will lead complex projects and act as the primary technical expert for the shop floor. You will balance hands-on troubleshooting of PLCs and servers with structured, GMP-compliant change management to support safe, efficient manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Leadership: Co - develop and support the site's overall automation strategy. Manage project pipelines, budgets, CAPEX/OPEX engineering tasks, and end-to-end hardware/software lifecycle planning.
  • Systems Operations & IT: Execute daily maintenance and troubleshooting for automation hardware (HMIs, PLCs). Administer if applicable underlying IT infrastructure, including Windows Servers, OS patching, OT network segmentation, and cybersecurity hygiene.
  • Process Equipment Expertise: Oversee automation systems for critical fill and finish operations, including filling lines, isolators, freeze dryers, autoclaves and building utilities.
  • GMP & CSV Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to cGMP, Data Integrity, and CSV regulations. Draft and update technical documentation, execute rigorous change control, and support validation activities.
  • Disaster Recovery: Maintain and regularly test backup/restore and disaster recovery procedures to ensure the uptime and validated state of all production equipment.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with manufacturing, QA, and maintenance teams to optimize systems. Manage vendor SLAs, maintain spare parts inventory, and provide on-call support for critical system alarms.


Your profile

We are looking for a motivated and committed professional who is ready to actively grow with us, combining in-depth technical knowledge with a pronounced cooperative spirit.

The ideal candidate possesses:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on industrial automation or IT experience within a GMP Pharma environment, ideally with direct exposure to fill and finish operations.
  • Strong technical proficiency in automation hardware (PLC & SCADA Systems), HMI/SCADA configuration, Windows Server administration, and OT cybersecurity fundamentals.
  • Proven leadership experience with excellent communication skills, structured problem-solving under pressure, and a strong ownership mindset.
  • Deep familiarity with GMP/CSV concepts (GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11) and modern data integration architecture.
  • Fluent in English (working language); German is a strong advantage for on-site shop floor communication.


Why us?

We offer a dynamic environment where you can contribute meaningfully, collaborate with exceptional minds, and unlock your full potential.
  
 Here's what sets ten23 apart:

  • A valuable and impactful career development opportunity in an inspiring environment
  • Flexible working arrangements and environment with an open culture and diverse workforce  
  • The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees
  • Our learning and self-developing culture offers a wide range of training options  
  • Competitive pension fund plan, annual bonus, and other financial and non-financial benefit 
At ten23 we believe in self-responsibility and mutual trust. Therefore, we will provide our employees as much flexibility as possible and limit any bureaucracy to a minimum, whilst ensuring compliance with all applicable laws.

jobs.title: Position(s) as Associate Professor in Accounting
jobs.description:
About the position

Oslo Business School is a relatively new business school (founded in 2014) focusing on teaching quality and excellence in research. The school has currently about 2000 students and 80 employees and offers study programs at Bachelor, Master, and PhD level. The Finance and Accounting group, one of the school’s five sections, is a vibrant and diverse group consisting of researchers that regularly publish in recognized international journals. Oslo Business School is located in downtown Oslo and is part of the Oslo Metropolitan University. The school is currently working on obtaining international accreditations and is strongly focusing on enhancing research output in high quality journals. 

Oslo Business School is expanding and invites applications for 1-2 faculty positions in accounting. The positions are within the Finance and Accounting group, and the person(s) appointed will contribute to Oslo Business School's research and teaching in accounting and auditing and related subjects. The formal recruitment will be at the associate professor level with tenure. Candidates who qualify may be promoted to full professor following their appointment.


Your main duties and areas of responsibility will be
  • teaching and supervision at the Bachelor, Master, and PhD level 
  • active contribution to the development of a high-quality education 
  • initiating and carrying out high quality academic research 
  • contributing to the continued development of the research group in accounting and auditing and the department’s study programmes 
  • academic-administrative tasks 
  • active contribution to the development of Oslo Business School, and OsloMet in general 
  • disseminating research outcomes to the academic community and to the broader society

Qualification requirements

The ranking of qualified applicants is based on scientific merits. Teaching experience, personal qualities and suitability for the position are also important factors. We mainly consider recent publications and the potential for future publications in high-quality journals. The candidates we hire should fit the profile of our bachelor and master programs and must be able to contribute to the school’s long-term academic development. We encourage women to apply.

Applicants must:

  • hold a PhD in accounting or related fields (or be close to completion) 
  • have published in international journals and/or document the potential for quality publications in accounting 
  • have good teaching skills 
  • written and oral proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish (minimum level B2), and English (Language requirements for employees at OsloMet)

Applicants who do not have adequate proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, will be offered Norwegian courses, and must acquire Norwegian skills corresponding to at least level B2 within three years of appointment.

The applicant must document relevant educational competence in accordance with OsloMet’s Guidelines for the assessment of educational competence at OsloMet. Applicants who do not possess the required educational qualifications must obtain them within two years of employment.

General criteria for appointments to academic positions are covered by the Regulations for appointment and promotion to academic posts.


It will be an advantage if you have
  • high quality research in recognized international journals
  • experience with research networks and externally funded projects
  • teaching and supervision experience from different degree levels
  • quantitative skills, related to empirical research or teaching
  • proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language
  • capability in communicating and cooperating with students and colleagues
  • a relevant professional credential (such as statsautorisert revisor)
  • ability to teach Norwegian accounting standards (GRS norsk regnskapslov)
  • personal qualities that contribute positively to the working environment

Personal qualities

OsloMet evaluates teaching qualifications in conjunction with interviews. It is important for OsloMet to reflect the population in our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavours to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work, under education or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer
  • engaging professional opportunities at Norway’s third largest university
  • an exciting job opportunity at a new and fast-growing business school in the middle of downtown Oslo 
  • participation in a dynamic professional environment, research groups, and unique academic community
  • a possibility to help map out the direction of a new and growing business school
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • interaction with a diverse student group
  • loan and pension arrangements through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • beneficial welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers
  • free Norwegian language classes to employees 
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMet’s pay policy for Associate Professor in code 1011, corresponding to 708 000 – 923 000 NOK per year. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. The salary depends on the qualifications of the applicant. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process and Expert Committee

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.
An expert committee will conduct the assessment of relevant applications. Before the application documents are sent to the expert committee, all applications will be reviewed by the faculty. Applications from unqualified candidates will not be forwarded to the expert committee for assessment. If the number of applications requires it, an internal screening committee at OsloMet will carry out an initial selection of candidates. The selected applicants will then be assessed by the expert committee. 

Please upload the following documents by the application deadline: 

  • application letter 
  • CV, letters of recommendations, and all pages of certificates/diplomas. Foreign education should be pre-approved, and a letter of approval must be attached. Information is available via the following link: Recognition of foreign education - to work in Norway | HK-dir 
  • a list of scientific publications/working papers 
  • up to 5 scientific publications (from the last five years), including your PhD thesis 
  • documentation of educational competence including a profiling document

For applicants who cannot document the required competencies in teaching in higher education have to develop this within two years from accession. OsloMet offers courses in teaching and learning in higher education which covers this requirement.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you have documents that cannot be uploaded electronically, please contact stale.bie@oslomet.no

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Stochastic Analysis and Computational Methods
jobs.description:
About the position

A position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Stochastic Analysis and Computational Methods is available at Department of Mathematics, within the section of Risk and Stochastics.

Starting date no later than January 31st, 2027.

The appointment is a full-time position and is for a period of three years (10% of which is devoted to other career-promoting work, usually in the form of teaching activities). 

Depending upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department, a fourth year may be considered. In this case, a workload of 25% is devoted to career promoting work, usually in the form of teaching and/or supervision duties. In this case, Postdoctoral fellows who are appointed for a period of four years are expected to acquire basic pedagogical competency in the course of their fellowship period within the duty component of 25%.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The position is bounded to the SURE-AI consortium agreement and its research scopes. The Centre for Sustainable, Risk-Averse, and Ethical AI or SURE-AI is a Norwegian AI centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (2025-2030). The primary objective is to create a new generation of algorithms for inference and decision-making by pushing the boundaries of the underlying computational techniques. SURE-AI researchers will drive a transformative leap in AI through a groundbreaking Centre initiative dedicated to making Artificial Intelligence more efficient, transparent and safe, addressing the critical challenges of resource consumption, behaviour unpredictability and ethical alignment with human and societal values. The centre involves senior researchers from well-renowned national and international research institutions, in close collaboration with industry and public sector. Overall, SURE-AI includes 19 national Norwegian partners, as well as researchers from 15 international institutions.

Six national research centres for Artificial Intelligence (AI) were launched in the Fall of 2025. These centres will foster interdisciplinary collaboration among researchers to address both scientific and societal challenges, develop new technologies, understand the impact of AI, and drive innovation across both the business and public sectors. This initiative is established and financed through the government's significant investment in artificial intelligence over the next five years

The present postdoctoral position is hosted at the Department of Mathematics, at Blindern campus in Oslo, which is the place of work.


Project description

The position is framed in the strongly interdisciplinary research group of Risk and Stochastics and the Community of SURE-AI. The focus is on the development of original mathematical methods for AI and its applications aimed at the modelling and analysis of complex phenomena particularly within economics and finance, energy finance, sustainable and ethical economics and insurance. 

We are interested in research projects that are deeply grounded in stochastic analysis and show also development of computational methods towards machine learning. The projects will focus on applications to risk-sensitive decision making and control, with the potential to address ethical and human alignment in machine learning research.

For this, candidates with a strong background in the areas of stochastic analysis, Malliavin calculus, forward and backward stochastic differential equations, signature methods, filtering, machine learning and computational stochastics are particularly welcome and are prioritized. Clear interest in computational methods towards applications is appreciated.

We are interested in candidates that can merge into an internationally oriented group with high ambitions in research excellency. It is expected that the fellow takes active part in both the research development and the group’s activities. 

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide the candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in stochastic analysis, probability or mathematical statistics, numerical methods for stochastics, forward and/or backward stochastic differential equations, stochastic control, stochastic filtering. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications:

  • Interdisciplinary research experience and/or attitude in the relevant areas is an advantage. 
  • Knowledge of computational methods for stochastics and programming skills.
  • Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Malliavin calculus, stochastic filtering, risk measures, signature methods.
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language may be an advantage for teaching and supervision (if applicable)

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

The fellow is expected to take part in the activities of the Section of Risk and Stochastics. We are expecting a person able to work in structured manner both independently and as part of a team, swiftly adapting to new tasks. In general, a positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods is an advantage. A genuine interest in taking part in the various aspects of the academic life with collaborative and pro-active attitude is highly appreciated. 
Good communication skills are important.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Project description (no more than 3 pages, excluding references)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. jobs.title: Area IT Manager Finland and Europe
jobs.description:
Ruukki Construction aims to drive the construction industry towards carbon neutrality with its products. Our 1,350 employees in 10 European countries and 14 specialized manufacturing sites provide steel-based building products and services for roofs and walls in sustainable buildings. We serve our customers locally under our main brands Ruukki and Plannja. Our net sales in 2024 were approximately EUR 481 million. We are of Nordic origin and share our values and long experience in the steel and construction industry with our parent company SSAB.

Do you want to be part of building a more sustainable future and be part of a professional and successful team in an international company? Maybe this is your new challenge!

We are looking fora strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

The role has two main managerial responsibility areas; Firstly, oversee local IT development and support activities in Finland, ensuring business continuity from the IT perspective. And in this context act as line manager for the area IT team: manage performance, recruitment, budgeting, and other HR responsibilities. Secondly, you will lead a team of regional IT managers in Central and Eastern Europe: you will set goals, monitor progress, optimize resource allocation and ensure that best practices are evaluated and implemented as part of the knowledge sharing process.

All in all, you will contribute to the implementation of Ruukkis IT and business strategies and roadmaps. And when fit for purpose act as project manager for selected initiatives, such as IT and production capability development, acquisitions, and carve-outs.

The preferred location is Alajärvi, or any of our location in South Ostrobothnia, Finland.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure day-to-day IT support and development activities are aligned with Ruukki and SSAB IT policies (executed by internal teams and external vendors).

Lead the development of the Area Europe IT roadmap and resource planning.

Manage team-level IT costs, including annual budgeting and development proposals.

Oversee contracts and vendor management, including invoicing.

Collaborate with SSAB common IT on infrastructure and application development.

Define and implement collaboration models with business stakeholders across Europe.

Act as a general point of contact for infrastructure-related topics within Ruukki Construction IT management.

What we are looking for

· Strong knowledge of business applications and IT infrastructure (including security).

· Experience in strategy and roadmap execution.

· Solid understanding of business process development.

· Strong project management skills.

· Familiarity with agile methodologies and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL).

· Proven vendor management skills.

· Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

· Has excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

· The ideal candidate communicates fluently in Finnish and in English both written and oral.

We Offer

Our workplace fosters collaboration and personal growth, and everything we do is guided by our commitment to sustainability. Safety, innovation and reliability are at the heart of our business and ensure that everyone in our community thrives. Great colleagues and a supportive work community. Healthy work-life-balance and flexibility (hybrid working model). Lunch and wellbeing benefits. Occupational health services and much more!

Location

Your home base will be Ruukki Alajärvi (South Ostrobothnia) Finland. Some domestic and international travel is required.

jobs.title: Bilklargjører søkes til Innlandet Bilutleie – 60 % stilling, førerkort klasse B kreves
jobs.description:
Vi søker en effektiv og pålitelig bilklargjører til vårt team i Gjøvik. Hos oss får du en variert og fysisk arbeidshverdag med klargjøring av leiebiler, og vi ser etter deg som liker å jobbe praktisk, effektivt og nøye. Erfaring er ikke nødvendig – opplæring gis.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som er nøye, pålitelig og tar stolthet i arbeidet du gjør. En bil skal ikke bare se ren ut -- den skal være ordentlig klargjort og klar for neste kunde.

Du må være grundig og ha et godt øye for detaljer, både når det gjelder vask og når du kontrollerer bilen for skader eller andre avvik. Vi ser også etter deg som tar ansvar, jobber selvstendig og sier ifra dersom du oppdager noe som ikke er som det skal.

Du trenger ikke ha erfaring fra bilutleie eller bilpleie fra før. Det viktigste er at du er lærevillig, effektiv og opptatt av å gjøre en skikkelig jobb.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Innlandet Bilutleie søker bilvasker / bilklargjører i Gjøvik

Vi søker en pålitelig og effektiv medarbeider til vask og klargjøring av våre leiebiler.

Arbeidsdagen vil hovedsakelig bestå av:

  • Innvendig og utvendig vask av biler

  • Støvsuging og rengjøring

  • Klargjøring og enkel kontroll av biler før utleie

  • Flytting av biler og andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til bilparken

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er pålitelig og møter til avtalt tid

  • Jobber effektivt og er opptatt av et godt resultat

  • Trives med fysisk arbeid og høyt tempo

  • Kan jobbe selvstendig, men også fungerer godt sammen med andre

  • Har førerkort klasse B -- dette er et krav

Tidligere erfaring med bilpleie eller klargjøring er en fordel, men ikke nødvendig. Du vil få nødvendig opplæring.

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet ca. 60 %, tilsvarende omtrent tre arbeidsdager i uken. Arbeidstid og konkrete dager avtales nærmere.

Vi ønsker en person som kan starte så snart som mulig.

Du trenger ikke skrive en lang søknad. Send oss noen korte ord om deg selv, når du kan starte og telefonnummeret ditt.

Arbeidssted: Gjøvik

Arbeidsgiver: Innlandet Bilutleie AS

Vi tilbyr

Hos Innlandet Bilutleie blir du en del av et lite og uformelt arbeidsmiljø med korte beslutningsveier og varierte arbeidsdager. Du får ansvar og tillit tidlig, samtidig som du får god opplæring i oppgavene.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et hyggelig og uformelt arbeidsmiljø

  • Varierte arbeidsdager med praktiske oppgaver

  • God opplæring -- erfaring er ikke nødvendig

  • Selvstendig arbeid og ansvar

  • Mulighet til å lære mer om bil, bilutleie og drift

  • Forutsigbar deltidsstilling med mulighet for mer arbeid ved behov

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Vi er en liten organisasjon der alle bidrar, og hvor det er kort vei fra idé til handling. For den rette personen kan det også være muligheter for mer ansvar og flere oppgaver over tid.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bilklargjører søkes til Innlandet Bilutleie -- 60 % stilling, førerkort klasse B kreves

jobs.title: Assistant or Associate Professor in Social Work (Tenure Track Levels 1-2) or Professor of Social Work
jobs.description:
The University of Lapland invites applications for the position of Assistant or Associate Professor in Social Work (Tenure Track Levels 1-2) or Professor of Social Work.

The research profile of the position focuses on social and health care service systems, the effectiveness of social work, and information and knowledge practices in social work. Global and societal transformations are reshaping professional social work practice and welfare service systems. At the same time, digital technologies and artificial intelligence are significantly changing knowledge practices, information management, and the organization of social work within service systems.

These developments raise new questions related to social justice, ethics, and professional values, creating a need for critical scholarly inquiry and the strengthening of the research base of social work through interdisciplinary and international collaboration. The Assistant/Associate Professor/Professor is expected to provide academic leadership in research, monitor developments in the discipline, and contribute to societal engagement, international collaboration, and scholarly networks in social work. The position includes responsibility for teaching and curriculum development, particularly in courses related to social and health care service systems and social policy at the bachelor's, master's, and doctoral levels. The successful candidate will supervise theses and doctoral dissertations and contribute to the development of teaching in collaboration with the degree programme staff.

The duties also include active collaboration with other faculties of the University of Lapland. The appointee will further strengthen international networks in research and education and participate in programme planning, administration, and academic governance. The position is located in the Discipline of Social Work, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Lapland. The discipline provides a multidisciplinary and dynamic academic environment. The Faculty of Social Sciences offers nationally recognized education and research in several social science disciplines through four degree programmes and seven major fields of study. The position offers an opportunity to build and lead a nationally and internationally high-quality research in collaboration with the faculty's research communities and other faculties of the University. The successful candidate will be actively supported in applying for competitive research funding, building international research networks, and preparing interdisciplinary research projects.

The position requires regular presence at the University of Lapland campus in Rovaniemi.

We offer

- An excellent academic community

- Diverse and inspiring tasks in research and education

- The stability and support of a well-established university

- Modern working facilities and tools

- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

- Support from experienced colleagues and expert teams

- Comprehensive occupational health care

- Sports, culture, and wellbeing benefits.

The University of Lapland offers a unique research and working environment characterized by northern social issues, the development of welfare services, international collaboration, and Arctic perspectives in social science research.

We expect

Applicants are required to hold a doctoral degree in Social Work and possess expertise in social work acquired through academic education and research. The position further requires the ability and motivation to develop multidisciplinary and interdisciplinary research collaboration within the university community as well as nationally and internationally.

In addition, applicants are expected to demonstrate experience in research projects related to:

- social and health care service systems

- the effectiveness of social work

- information management

- information and knowledge practices or

- digital environments and transformations in social work.

Applicants are expected to have a good command of English. Knowledge of Finnish or strong motivation to learn Finnish is also required. For an international applicant or a non-native Finnish speaker, reasonable proficiency in Finnish may be required within five years of appointment, if necessary. The University of Lapland supports international staff members in their integration into the university community and in learning Finnish. According to Section 30 of the University of Lapland Regulations, the criteria and evaluation procedures for Assistant Professorships (Assistant Professor and Associate Professor levels) are defined within the University's Tenure Track model.

Additional merits include

- University pedagogical studies, teacher education studies, or other demonstrated pedagogical merits

- Evidence of multidisciplinary or interdisciplinary research collaboration within the academic community, nationally, or internationally

Recruitment level and evaluation criteria

The position may be filled at the level of Assistant/Associate Professor (Tenure Track Level 1 or Level 2) or Professor, depending on the qualifications, achievements, and career stage of the selected candidate.

Application

The following documentation must be submitted along with the application:

- Curriculum Vitae according to the [model of the Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae) (TENK)

- List of publications according to the guidelines of the Research Council of Finland

Odotamme, että sinulla on hyvät asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Työ marketissamme on vuorotyötä, joka tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden vaihteleviin työvuoroihin ja joustavaan arkeen.
Kaupallinen koulutus antaa hyvän perustan tekemiselle, mutta arvostamme erityisesti oikeaa asennetta ja tahtotilaa palvella asiakkaita laadukkaasti. Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen asiakaspalvelutyöstä vähittäiskaupassa ja kaupan erilaisista tehtävistä, kuitenkaan aikaisempi kokemus ei ole välttämätöntä. Tärkeintä on oma-aloitteinen ote työhön, joustavuus ja halu tehdä työtä tiimissämme. Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja erilaisiin työvuoroihin sekä opastamme onnistumisiin pitkin matkaa.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, kivan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä halutessasi urallasi. Sinä saat käyttöösi sekä S-ryhmän että PKO:n erittäin hyvät, jopa Suomen parhaaksi kutsutut, henkilöstöedut (https://pko.fi/toissa-meilla/palkka-ja-edut).
PKO tarjoaa myös keskimääräistä laajemmat ja kattavammat työterveyspalvelut ja työntekijämme ovat vakuutettu myös työajan ulkopuolella vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Creo Center is a Nordic product development partner with operations in Finland and Sweden, helping both local and international organizations create and develop innovations across different industries. We have strong interest in new techniques and innovative solutions, with our clients primarily consisting of international R&D companies, manufacturing firms, or startups with innovative product ideas. United by our passion for product development, we help our clients turn ideas into success.

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior R&D Engineer to join our team!

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop mechanical systems, components, and assemblies for advanced technology products

* Create detailed 3D models and manufacturing documentation using Siemens NX

* Manage product data and engineering documentation in Teamcenter

* Support prototype builds, testing activities, and product validation collaborating with different suppliers

* Ensure designs comply with relevant industry standards, quality requirements, and safety regulations

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related technical field

* Minimum of 7 years of experience in mechanical engineering within engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, or high-tech industries

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

* Extensive hands-on experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter

* Fluent communication skills in both English and Finnish

* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams

* Willingness to work on-site in the Western Uusimaa region

* Flexibility and willingness to travel within Southern Finland, particularly to supplier and manufacturing sites

Preferred Qualifications:

* Knowledge of semiconductor, vacuum process, precision equipment, or similar high-technology industries

* Familiarity with ASME and related industrial standards

Why Creo Center?

At Creo Center, you'll join a community of over 160 product development professionals, where expertise thrives and grows through multidisciplinary collaboration. Our network of experienced colleagues and diverse customer base across multiple industries provide continuous opportunities for learning, professional growth, and the development of new expertise. We support your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package that includes a lunch benefit, mobile phone benefit, commuter benefit or company bike benefit, extended occupational healthcare, and comprehensive leisure-time accident insurance. We believe in shared success, which is why every year we distribute a portion of our operating profit among all employees through our People Bonus program.

Join us!

Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 11.10.2026. This position is permanent and full-time, with the start date to be agreed upon.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact R&D Unit Manager Benjamin Ekström +358 41 507 7201 on weekdays.

Description de tâches:
Nous sommes aujourd'hui l'un des plus grands employeurs du Grand-Duché et comptons parmi les recruteurs les plus actifs. Attentifs aux besoins de notre Groupe, comme de ceux de nos employés et employées, nous recrutons, intégrons et accompagnons chaque année plusieurs dizaines de nouveaux collaborateurs et collaboratrices de tous horizons, de tous profils. L'expansion de nos activités nous pousse à la recherche incessante de nouveaux talents qui, tous ensemble, nourrissent la diversité de notre grande famille CFL.

Notre Service Maintenance Infrastructure se propose d'engager, pour une entrée au 1er avril 2027, des

AGENTS / AGENTES DE MAINTENANCE

Ce poste est à pourvoir à temps plein.

L'embauche est définitive à la suite d'une période de stage rémunérée de 1 an, comprenant des formations et des évaluations.

Votre mission :

* Vous assurez la réalisation de travaux d'entretien et de maintenance des voies ferrées et des alentours
* Vous travaillez sous la surveillance et la responsabilité de votre responsable qui vous transmet des instructions claires et exécutez les travaux qui vous ont été assignés de façon appropriée
* Vous réalisez des travaux de maintenance et d'entretien des voies et appareils de voie (rails, traverses, aiguillages, accès, voies et passages à niveau), maintenance des pistes et curage des évacuations d'eau
* Vous effectuez pendant la période hivernale des travaux d'élagage, de débroussaillage et de taille des haies aux alentours des voies ferrées
* Vous participez aux actions de déneigement et de salage des accès aux gares et sur les quais
* Vous vous occupez de la manutention des machines d'entretien

Votre profil :

* Vous avez au minimum accompli la scolarité obligatoire
* Vous maîtrisez les langues allemande et française aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit, et le luxembourgeois à l'oral
* Vous remplissez les conditions d'aptitude physique suivantes :

o bonne acuité auditive

o bonne vision des couleurs

o bonne mobilité physique sur terrain inégal

o port de charges lourdes

* Vous acceptez de suivre des instructions et des procédures
* Vous avez un sens développé des responsabilités et un esprit de sécurité
* Vous avez un bon esprit d'équipe et d'initiative
* Vous êtes de nature dynamique, polyvalente et rigoureuse
* Vous acceptez de travailler à l'extérieur par tous les temps
* Vous êtes flexible pour travailler les week-ends, les jours fériés et la nuit en fonction des travaux prévus
* Vous acceptez de faire des astreintes
* Vous êtes titulaire du permis de conduire B
* Vous avez la nationalité d'un pays membre de l'Union européenne.

À la recherche d'un nouveau défi professionnel ?

Votre recruteuse, Caroline FELGEN reste à votre entière disposition par e-mail pour tout renseignement complémentaire :



Vos obligations administratives :

Découvrez notre blog dédié à nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices, à leurs métiers et leurs passions : www.WEARECFL.lu

Le Groupe CFL, employeur de l'égalité des chances

Au sein du Groupe CFL, nous nous engageons en faveur de l'égalité et de l'inclusion. Nous œuvrons pour un environnement de travail respectueux et adapté, où la diversité prend racine et où l'inclusion est la norme, car nous savons que le sentiment d'unité permet à chacun et chacune d'atteindre son plein potentiel.

jobs.title: International Tax Senior Advisor (m/f)
jobs.description:
International Tax Senior Advisor

locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100208

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.

You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2–4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.
We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.

The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

jobs.title: Second de cuisine (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

DESCRIPTIF DE POSTE
SECOND DE CUISINE – grand café

SUPERIEUR HIERARCHIQUE : chef de cuisine

ENCADREMENT : OUI

MISSION PRINCIPALE:

Le second de cuisine est chargé de seconder le chef de cuisine dans la gestion opérationnelle de la cuisine du restaurant GRAND CAFE. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec lui dans le but d'assurer une production culinaire de haute qualité et de satisfaire les attentes des clients. Il est également responsable de la supervision d'une équipe composée de chefs de partie, de commis et plongeurs, tout en garantissant le respect des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire.

TACHES ET RESPONSABILITES:

Management:

• Il assiste le chef dans la planification et l'organisation de l'ensemble des activités quotidiennes de la cuisine
• Il supervise les chefs de partie et les commis afin d'assurer une production culinaire professionnelle et constante
• Il motive, encourage et donne le rythme à l'équipe lors du service
• Il participe activement à la formation et au suivi des membres de l'équipe, en transmettant son savoir-faire et en favorisant leur développement professionnel

Mise en place:

• Il contrôle la propreté de la cuisine et des frigos, en cas de non-respect des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité il en réfère au personnel de cuisine
• Il organise les tâches du personnel de cuisine de manière détaillée en fonction de la fiche de mise en place établie
• Il allume les fours
• Il se tient informé auprès du maitre d'hôtel du nombre de réservations pour anticiper le service à venir et l'informe de changements éventuels de carte, de portions limitées, de recommandations particulières à faire aux clients
• Il contrôle que chaque chef de partie a bien suivi sa fiche de mise en place à chaque début de service et qu'il l'a bien remplie en fin de service

Production:

• Il participe, et est force de proposition dans l'élaboration des menus, plats et fiches techniques
• Il redirige les commandes clients et leurs envois vers les différentes parties
• Il contrôle l'application de toutes les directives concernant la fabrication des plats, leur qualité et leur présentation
• Il corrige les erreurs de préparation et de présentation avant que les plats ne soient envoyés
• Il organise et contrôle l'envoi des suites de plats
• Il maintient une communication régulière avec les autres départements du restaurant, notamment le service en salle, pour garantir une coordination optimale

Hygiène – approvisionnement:

• Il applique et veille au bon respect des règles d'hygiène de sécurité alimentaire quotidiennement
• Il contrôle la propreté de l'ensemble de la cuisine : plonge, plans de travail, ustensiles, machines, sols, frigos...
• Il réceptionne les marchandises, contrôle leur température, s'assure qu'elles soient conformes aux commandes passées et les range
• Il vérifie que chaque production du jour soit étiquetée
• Il relève quotidiennement la température des frigos et contrôle les DLC en veillant à la bonne rotation des produits selon FIFO
• Il contrôle les stocks, en veillant à minimiser les pertes et le gaspillage, il effectue les commandes nécessaires auprès des fournisseurs


PREREQUIS:

• Avoir d'excellente connaissance des techniques de cuisine et méthodes de préparation
• Être doté de capacités managériales développées, une aptitude à encadrer et à motiver son équipe
• Avoir une communication claire et efficace
• Avoir un sens aigu de l'organisation, de la planification et de la gestion des priorités
• Être orienté résultats, capable de travailler efficacement dans un environnement sous pression
• Connaitre les normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire

Remarque:  Travail le soir possible jusqu'à 00h00

Autres compétences requises:  5 ans dans un poste identique
