jobs.title: Zámečník kolejových vozidel, Mechanici a opraváři kolejových vozidel
jobs.description:
Místo výkonu práce: Dělnická č.p. 1408/29
Děčín VI-Letná, 405 02  Děčín 2

Jsme ryze česká, rodinná firma s více než stoletou tradicí, umíme revidovat a opravovat nákladní železniční vozy. Děláme to profesionálně, s nadšením, respektem a láskou. Máme zákazníky z celé Evropy. Dokud budou jezdit vlaky, budeme tu taky.
U nás se rychle rozhodujeme, máme přehledné procesy a jasné postupy, umíme naslouchat, reagujeme na podněty, problémy neřešíme. Jsme stabilní, spolehlivý a slušný zaměstnavatel. O svých více než 350 zaměstnanců se staráme, vážíme se svých lidí i lidské práce. I díky tomu rosteme, rozvíjíme se, modernizujeme a daří se nám. U nás platí podání ruky, neslibujeme, co nemůžeme splnit, jednáme na rovinu. Šikovní, ochotní a pracovití kolegové se u nás mají dobře.
Topíme, svítíme, opravujeme. Práci máme nasmlouvanou na několik let dopředu, daří se nám, proto i dnes nabíráme nové kolegy. Rádi mezi nás přijmeme lidi, kteří se nebojí práce. Právě teď oslovujeme ty z vás, kteří věří, že se k nám hodí, mají rádi vlaky a bavilo by je u nás pracovat 5, 10, 15, 20 i více let.
Hledáme totiž šikovné a spolehlivé dělníky pro pracoviště Děčín.

Náplň práce:
Práce při opravě nákladních vlaků - broušení, čištění, tryskání, vrtání, soustružení, demontáž, kontrola, výměna dílů, montáž… jedná se o dělnickou pozici. Hlavní činností RYKO je provádět technickou kontrolu železničních vozů. Budete ten, kdo umí rozebrat jednotlivé části vagónu, zkontrolovat je, opravit nebo vyměnit a poté změřit. Pracujete s úhlovou bruskou, pneu nářadím, gola sadou, autogenem a někteří i se svářečkou. Vaším úkolem bude rozebrat šroubové spoje, odmontovat nebo namontovat díl, umět narovnat plech nebo vyměnit pororošt nebo prkno. Pracujete u nás také s měřidly, měřícími zařízeními a s počítačem. Umíte nejen opravit rozbitou část vozu, ale i vyplnit protokol, namazat nárazník nebo provést zkoušku brzy. Ze zámečníka jsme schopni vychovat paliče, svářeče, brzdaře, lakýrníka, písmomalíře nebo tlakaře. Ze zámečníka se může stát také četař nebo mistr. Pracujete u nás s železničními nákladními vozy a jejich jednotlivými díly v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu od pondělí do pátku.

Požadujeme:
Vzdělání - vyučení výhodou (zámečník, mechanik, strojař, automechanik, instalatér..)
Manuální zručnost
Vhodná pracovní zkušenost, zkušenost s výše uvedenými pracemi
Pečlivost, přesnost a zodpovědnost
Ochota a zájem pracovat a občas chodit na přesčasy (12 hodin/měsíc)

Nabízíme:
• Několikaměsíční zaškolení a zapracování pod vedením zkušených kolegů, kteří u nás dlouhé roky pracují
• Práci na dlouhodobě nasmlouvaných zakázkách, stabilní, rodinné prostředí a lidský přístup
• Práci v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu (ranní a odpolední směny), Po - Pá, občas • So, neděle vždy volné.

Termín nástupu: dohodou

Mzdové podmínky:
• Mzda má fixní a variabilní složku, která je závislá na výkonu, každý potřebný přesčas platíme a za nadstandartní počty přesčasových hodin jsou zvláštní bonusy
• Výše nástupní mzdy dle znalostí a zkušenostní, konkrétní mzdové podmínky pro nástup, období zapracování a možnosti růstu vysvětlíme u pohovoru

Zaměstnanecké výhody:
• 5 týdnů dovolené
• Možnost stravování v závodní jídelně s příspěvkem
• Pracovní oblečení + jeho údržbu
• Benefitní systém - kafetérie
• Zvýhodněný telefonní tarif
• Příspěvek na penzijní připojištění

jobs.title: Sosiaaliohjaaja Etelä-Suomen alueelle - Lastensuojelun, perhesosiaalityön ja aikuispalvelun tiimi
jobs.description:
**Haemme kolmea sosiaaliohjaajaa Etelä-Suomen avopalveluiden tiimiin. Tällä hetkellä haemme yhtä (1) kokoaikaista- ja kolmea (3) tuntityöntekijää.** Lähtökohtaisesti toivomme, että mikäli työskentelet meillä tuntityöntekijänä, olisit valmis työskentelemään yli 50 h/kk - mahdollisuuksien mukaan voimme tarjota sinulle haluamasi määrän työtunteja aina kokoaikaiseen työhön asti. Huomioi, että voit halutessasi hakea myös molempia tehtäviä.

Tulevaan Sosiaalipalvelut - olemme 100 % suomalainen, valtakunnallisesti toimiva yhteiskunnallinen perheyritys. Meille työssä tärkeintä ovat asiakkaat ja se, että he saavat laadukasta, oikea-aikaista ja hyvin suunniteltua palvelua.

Vaikka työ on itsenäistä, et ole koskaan yksin. Työkavereiden sekä esihenkilöiden tuki on aina saatavilla, olemme avoin ja matalan kynnyksen organisaatio, jossa kaikki ovat samaa työtä tekeviä työkavereita. Tehtävämme on tuottaa Suomen parhaita sosiaalialan palveluja - yhdessä ja hyvällä fiiliksellä.

Olemme suomalaisen työn liiton jäsen sekä suositeltu sotetyöpaikka. Sote Solutions toteuttaman työpaikkatutkimuksen mukaan henkilöstömme työlle ja työtyytyväisyydelle antama arvio on 94 %.

Tutustu tarkemmin toimintaamme videon muodossa (7min): https://youtu.be/UClN2loxz7w

Mitä me haemme ja mitä tarjoamme sinulle: Haluaisitko sosiaaliohjaajaksi työskentelemään osana toiminnallista, ammattitaitoista, persoonallista ja huumorintajuista tiimiä?

Haluaisitko työskennellä itsenäisesti ja suunnitella omat työvuorosi? Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä ja tärkeää työtä yhteiskunnallisessa yrityksessä? Onko sinulle tärkeää, että pääset vaikuttamaan työsi sisältöön ja työn suunnitteluun?

Jos vastasit kyllä ja olet sosiaali- tai terveysalan ammattilainen, jolla on kokemusta lasten, nuorten tai perheiden kanssa työskentelystä, ota yhteyttä ja tule mukaan tekemään Suomen parhaita sosiaalialan avopalveluja Etelä-Suomen alueelle.

Meillä sinuun luotetaan ja saat vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Jokaista työntekijää ja heidän ammattitaitoaan arvostetaan ja tiimissämme saat olla täysin oma itsesi.

Toivomme, että omaat kehitysmyönteisen ja avoimen työotteen sekä kestät elämän keskeneräisyyttä. Edellytyksenä on, että sinulta löytyy oppimisen halua ja intoa uusiin sekä vaihteleviin tehtäviin sekä työyhteisösi kehittämiseen.

Etelä-Suomen toimitiloissa voi tavata työkavereita ja harrastaa asiakkaiden kanssa monipuolisesti. Malminkartanon viihtyisä nuorisotila tarjoaa hyvät puitteet yhteiselle tekemiselle ja harrastamiselle. Maltsussa voit pelailla vaikka biljardia tai tehdä käsitöitä asiakkaiden kanssa. Etelä-Suomen päätoimipaikkamme on Pakilan toimintakeskus, jossa on yli 500m2 toiminnallista tilaa sisältäen mm. seinäkiipeilysalin, koripallokentän, saunatilat ja eri toimistohuoneita asiakastapaamisia varten.

Tulevaan Sosiaalipalvelut toimii Etelä-Suomessa, Keski-Suomessa, Lahdessa ja Rovaniemellä.

Sosiaaliohjaajana työskentelet pääsääntöisesti Etelä-Suomen alueella. Painotus on Espoon alueella. Vaikka työalue on laaja, rakennamme sinulle yhdessä sellaisen työkokonaisuuden, että kulkeminen ja työn suunnittelu on mahdollisimman helppoa. Työhösi kuuluu perhetyötä, tehostettua perhetyötä, ammatillista tukihenkilötyötä sekä aikuisasiakkaiden kanssa tehtävää kotiin vietävää tukityötä ja sosiaaliohjausta.

Toimit sosiaaliohjaajana ja tärkeänä tukikontaktina omille asiakasperheille tai nuorille/lapsille ja aikuisasiakkaille - haemme osaajia pääsääntöisesti pitkäkestoiseen työsuhteeseen. Meille on tärkeää, että asiakas saa tukea ja turvaa arkeen tutulta työntekijältä ja käytämme työssä mahdollisimman vähän sijaisia - kaikki työ toteutetaan meillä oman henkilökunnan toimesta eikä käytössä ole esimerkiksi vuokratyövoimaa tai alihankkijoita.

Työajat ovat vaihtelevia, mutta työ toteutuu pääsääntöisesti arkisin klo 8 ja 20 välillä - toimimme perheiden aikataulujen mukaan ja työ painottuu iltapäiväaikaan. Työtä on kuitenkin mahdollisuus tehdä myös aamuaikoina ja sinulla on oman työsi ammattilaisena varsin vapaat kädet kalenterin ja työaikojen suunnitteluun. Tuemme ja autamme, mutta emme tee puolesta: meillä luotetaan jokaisen omaan kykyyn rakentaa itselleen sopivin työviikko. jobs.title: IT Admin / IT Support Specialist, ReOrbit, Helsinki
jobs.description:
ReOrbit is looking for a proactive and solutions-driven IT Administrator / IT Support Specialist to support our growing team and help keep our technology running smoothly across all locations.

As our IT Administrator, you will be the go-to person for ensuring a seamless IT experience for employees, both onsite and remotely. Youll play a key role in maintaining reliable systems, supporting modern workplace tools, and enabling the team to work efficiently and securely every day.

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.

Core responsibilities:

- End-user IT support (Windows, Office 365, Google Workspace)

- Onboarding/offboarding — account creation, device provisioning, access management

- Active Directory / Entra ID and Group Policy administration

- Device management via Intune/MDM

- Hardware support: laptops, printers, mobiles, meeting room AV

- Ticket handling via Atlassian JIRA Service Management

- WiFi and network troubleshooting (LAN/WAN/VPN, connectivity issues)

- Application access management — provisioning, permissions and license assignment across M365, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Dynamics

- Shared mailbox access and licensing administration

- Documentation of processes, user help guides, and basic infrastructure setup notes

Skills and Requirements:

- 3 years in IT administration / end-user support

- Hands-on AD, Intune, and Microsoft 365 administration experience

- Comfortable being a hands-on, on-site presence with minimal supervision

- Fluent English (Finnish a plus, not required)

Application instructions and further information:

This is a six-month temporary agency employment, after which there is an opportunity to become directly employed by ReOrbit.

Register as an applicant and complete the application form carefully, and attach your CV to your application. In your application, please highlight how your strengths support the different aspects and focus areas of the role.

ReOrbit may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies.


ReOrbit

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.

ReOrbits top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.

jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Tammisaareen
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle ruotsinkieliselle seniorille

Haemme hoiva-avustajia osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Tammisaareen. Asiakkaalla tarve usealle käynnille päivässä, joten haemme tähän helpperitiimiä jakamaan käynnit.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

- suihkuapua

- voinnin tarkkailua

- kotona pärjäämisen tukemista

- liikkumisessa tukemista


Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for a postdoctoral research fellow in numerical mathematics for a period of 3 years.
 
About the postdoctoral project:

The postdoctoral position is part of the project “Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods for Two-Phase Flow” (PANum) funded by the Research Council of Norway. The project is a joint collaboration between Western Norway University of Applied Sciences and Hasselt University in Belgium.

In PANum the goal is to formulate and implement mathematical methods that are not only robust, efficient and have a low numerical error, but that also guarantee that important physical properties are fulfilled in the numerical solution. Ultimately, PANum will lead to a computational algorithm that reliably simulates two-phase flow.

The postdoctoral project will be part of developing and analyzing relevant numerical methods and implement them in an open-source framework that will be made openly available for others to use. This will be relevant for example for CO2 storage and design of fuel cells. 


Research environment:

The PANum project is situated in the Engineering Computing research group at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and in the computational mathematics group (CMAT) at Hasselt University. Both groups focus strongly on numerical analysis and mathematical modelling. The prospective postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with Carina Bringedal and Erlend Storvik from Engineering Computing, Jochen Schütz from CMAT, as well as the current PhD and master students connected to the PANum project.

 

Postdoctoral research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is campus Bergen or campus Førde. 


Qualifications:

Criteria for appointment to the position of postdoctoral fellow are regulated in Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven.

Applicants must have earned a PhD degree in computer science, simulation science, applied mathematics or in a closely related field, or have submitted the PhD thesis before the application deadline. The PhD must have been awarded within 4 weeks after the application deadline. The scientific profile of qualified candidates must be within numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs.

 

A solid background in both the following fields is required:

  • Numerical analysis for ODEs and PDEs
  • Scientific programming using Python, MATLAB, C++, Julia, or similar

Furthermore, experience within:

  • collaborative code development and usage of version control tools like git
  • asymptotic methods, like two-scale asymptotic expansions or matched asymptotic expansions, for PDEs

will be considered an advantage when candidates are ranked. 

In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated:

  • Quality and relevance of PhD thesis
  • Quality and relevance of publications
  • Ability to work in intersection of theoretical and applied research
  • Ability to collaborate, lead the writing of research papers, ability to initiate and advance research, and research and scientific leadership potential
  • Oral and written good communication skills in English.

 

Career plan:

The person appointed shall, together with the institute, prepare a career plan that specifies the skills the postdoctoral researcher is to acquire. Competence goals shall be set both for the postdoctoral project and for any other career‑advancing work included in the position. The postdoctoral researcher will have access to career guidance.


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation should be uploaded as an attachment to the online application: 

  • A brief cover letter (max one page) including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
  • PhD thesis
  • Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degrees. If you have not yet been awarded your PhD degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the submission of the PhD thesis.
  • Copies of up to 5 selected academic publications
  • Names and contact details of 2 references (names, relation to candidate, email and telephone number).

Short-listed candidates might be required to give a research presentation, in addition to an interview. 

 

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

 

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

 

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

 

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.


Salary and benefits:

Exciting and stimulating work as part of a strong international academic environment.


An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The position as postdoctoral researcher is paid according to the Government's salary regulation, in position code 1352.


There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no/en for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte"). Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences therefore aims to achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons with diverse backgrounds.

Information about the applicants may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications.


Contacts:

1) Professor Carina Bringedal, project leader of PANum

phone: +47 55 58 79 76, e-mail: carina.bringedal@hvl.no 

2) Associate Professor Therese B. Sjursen, assistant department leader

phone: +47 97 14 46 69 , e-mail: Therese.Berge.Sjursen@hvl.no 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences has a strong academic and research environment, offering programmes at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels. The department has around 1,100 students and more than 120 staff members, and plays a key role in advancing technologies for digitalisation and the green transition.

We offer education across our campuses in Førde, Bergen and Haugesund, with six study programmes in computer science and electrical engineering, and teaching contributions in mathematics, statistics and physics.

The department hosts active research groups in areas such as software engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, human-computer interaction and sensor networks, and collaborates closely with industry and public sector partners.

jobs.description:
Who we are looking for

As our Founding Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be the engine behind our sales pipeline - the first Birdsview person many prospects talk to. You'll open doors across Europe and beyond, working closely with our sales team to turn interest into qualified opportunities.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding BDA, you will be the engine behind our international growth. The role is to reach the right prospects, understand the problems they face, and show them what our technology does. You will build target account lists in HubSpot, make cold calls, drive LinkedIn and email outreach, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly established sales team, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the target list
    Research accounts across Europe and North America, and find the people who actually make the decision.

  • Run outbound
    Personalised outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn - plus follow-up on inbound leads and contacts from conferences.

  • Qualify and book
    Qualify opportunities, book meetings for the sales team, and keep our CRM clean enough that we can see what works.

  • Know the product and the market
    Deeply enough to have real conversations, not scripted ones.

  • Sharpen the message
    Feed back what you hear from prospects so marketing can build on it.

What we're looking for

  • Hunger and dedication to win.

  • Clear writing, thoughtful research, and confidence on the phone.

  • Outbound experience in SaaS, tech or another B2B role is a plus, not a requirement. Able to build pipeline yourself.

  • Organised and self-driven.

  • Comfortable working in a CRM. We use HubSpot.

  • At home where the process is still being figured out, you're helping figuring it out.

  • Fluent in English. Norwegian, German, Spanish or French is a strong plus given where our customers are.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary, commission, and equity - become an owner.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

View the full details for the job here.

Birdsview is building the "MRI for concrete", turning scans into clear answers about what's inside a structure, without breaking it open. Survey companies, structural engineers, and construction companies in 9 countries already use it in the field.

Birdsview is building the "MRI for concrete", turning a scan into clear answers about what's inside a structure, without breaking it open. Survey companies, structural engineers, and construction companies in 9 countries already use it in the field.

jobs.title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
jobs.description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver
Som restaurantansvarlig får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du blandt andet skal:

•    Lede og koordinere restaurantteamet under vagterne
•    Fordele arbejdsopgaver og administrere personalets pauser
•    Sikre en effektiv og velfungerende service
•    Tage godt imod gæsterne og hjælpe til, hvor der er behov
•    Overvåge servicekvaliteten og sikre høj kundetilfredshed
•    Håndtere gæstespørgsmål og eventuelle reklamationer professionelt
•    Koordinere samarbejdet mellem køkken og serveringspersonale
•    Åbne og/eller lukke restauranten samt foretage kasseafstemning
•    Sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår ren, organiseret og klar til service
•    Medvirke til oplæring af nye medarbejdere
•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten
•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen
•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder
•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret
•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne
•    Har fokus på kvalitet og gæsteoplevelser

Vi tilbyder

•    Helårsansættelse
•    Mulighed for bolig
•    Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor
•    Afslappet omgangstone og godt humør i hverdagen
•    Nogle af de gladeste gæster, fordi vi laver god mad
•    Gode kollegaer, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab
•    En hektisk, spændende og sjov højsæson
•    Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

Arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 10.00 og 21.00, på alle ugens dage

---------------------------------------------------------------

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the restaurant.
 Your responsibilities will include:
•    Leading and coordinating the restaurant team during service
•    Allocating tasks and managing staff breaks
•    Ensuring efficient and smooth-running service

•    Ensuring the restaurant is always clean, organized, and ready for service
•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees
•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service
•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

We are looking for someone who:
•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry
•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment
•    Accommodation available
•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits
•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere
•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food
•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team
•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season
•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working Hours
Working hours will be scheduled between 10:00 am and 9:00 pm, seven days a week.

Interested?
If this sounds like the opportunity for you, please send your application and CV to smag@smag-toscana.dk

Subject line: Restaurant Manager

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will appoint the right candidate as soon as they are found.

We look forward to hearing from you

jobs.title: Associate Professor (100 %, three years) in snow science / snow avalanches
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

We are seeking a three-year fixed-term Associate Professor with a focus on snow science at the Department of Geosciences at The Faculty of Science and Technology, UiT the Arctic University of Norway. The position is attached to the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group.

Tromsø is a vibrant Arctic city surrounded by dramatic mountains, fjords and accessible wilderness — an exceptional living laboratory for snow and mountain research. The region offers year-round opportunities for fieldwork, easy access to skiing and mountaineering, and outstanding nature experiences (midnight sun in summer, northern lights in winter). We value work-life balance and outdoor culture here, which many researchers find inspiring for both research and personal life.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The department

The Department of Geosciences has currently 16 permanent scientific staff positions, 21 post-doctoral fellows and researchers, 24 PhD students and 15 technical/administrative positions. The Department includes three scientific groups: (1) Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards group, (2) Sedimentary Systems, Paleoclimates and Environments group, and (3) Geophysics, Glaciology and Oceanography group. It also hosts the Centre of Excellence iC3: Centre for ice, Cryosphere, Carbon and Climate . The Department is also a member of iEarth - Centre for Integrated Earth Science Education. We offer courses at all levels from bachelor to PhD studies and hosts approximately 150 students.

Over the last decade, the department has strategically built up expertise and research and education activities in geohazards. Geohazards is now a key focus area for the department, with established networks, ongoing projects and ambitions to further expand capabilities in snow science, avalanches and related processes. Earlier work has focused on rock slopes, slush flows, wet snow avalanches, climate adaptation and hazard/runout modelling. We would like to develop this research direction. The position benefits from active connections to the Department of Physics and Technology, Department of Technology and Safety and the Center for Avalanche Research and Education (CARE), and interdisciplinary research is encouraged to strengthen UiT’s position as a driver of Arctic knowledge, such as incorporating elements of psychology, preparedness and climate research.


The position’s field of research/field of work

The successful candidate is expected to:

  • Conduct high-quality research that strengthens UiT’s snow science portfolio within the snow science and geohazards thematic area. Research may also be interdisciplinary, and a connection with CARE and other UiT institutes is encouraged.
  • Teach undergraduate and advanced graduate courses, as well as participate in teaching of the field courses organized by the scientific group. The successful candidate will be expected to fulfil basic pedagogical competence within two years.
  • Supervise students at all levels, including MSc and PhD students.
  • Build external networks and represent the department at meetings, conferences and community outreach events.
  • Respond to media enquiries within your field.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to secure external funding and contribute to establishing permanent snow science capability at UiT.

It is expected that the participant will participate in disseminating research to a wider public. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting

Associate Professor Louise Daines-Vick, phone + 47 90 47 30 83, email: louise.m.vick@uit.no

Professor/Head of Department (interim) Anders Schomacker, phone + 47 95 52 34 64, email: anders.schomacker@uit.no


Qualifications

For this three-year fixed-term position as Associate Professor with a focus on snow science the applicants

  • must have a PhD in geosciences, physics, mathematics or a closely related field and a documented publication record in snow science and/or related geohazards. 
  • must have experience in, and a strong dedication to, field-based research and navigating snowy terrain. A track record or commitment to acquisition of external funding is desired.  The research should complement the existing research strengths within the fields of the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group, which includes the field of geohazards. 
  • must have an ability to communicate effectively in English. 
  • documented pedagogical competence. All applicants for teaching and research positions shall document their pedagogical competence. You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at higher education level. This includes basic skills in planning, conducting, evaluating and developing teaching and guidance. Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years.
  • Norwegian language skills: The position requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

The applicants should have expertise in one or several aspects of snow avalanches and geohazards. Research approaches may include, for example, remote sensing, numerical and physical modelling, laboratory experiments, and field measurements on snow, slush, debris, or mixed materials. 

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Pedagogical competence

All applicants for teaching and research positions must document their educational competence in their application.

Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years. UiT offers courses in educational competence to employees.

You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at university and college level.This entails basic skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and developing teaching and supervision. 

See how to document educational competence: About the pedagogical portfolio - Result  (English guide at the bottom of the page)


We offer
  • A stimulating international research environment within the geohazards theme and opportunities for collaboration across UiT.
  • Support for career development, supervision of students and external funding applications
  • Access to university research infrastructure, administrative and technical support, and professional development (mentoring, courses and workshops)
  • You will join a thriving geosciences environment with active projects, a strong student cohort and close interdisciplinary collaboration. You will have access to relevant laboratory and field equipment, opportunities to participate in and lead field campaigns, and support for outreach and stakeholder engagement
  • Allocated funds to support your research, travel and equipment needs
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Access to the department cabin Heiahytta for a reasonable rental fee
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.


Work- and salary conditions 

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

The allocation of working hours is flexible and allocated on a case-by-case basis. In general, Associate Professors will spend an equal amount of time on teaching and research and development work after time spent on other duties has been deducted. As a norm, the time resources spent on administrative duties constitutes 5 % for academic staff. 

The remuneration for Associate Professor is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1011, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 700000,-  to 900000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases, a higher salary may be considered. 

As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes available. For more information see: spk.no.


Application

The application must include: 

  • Cover letter including a short description of interests and reasons for applying for the position  
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all degrees, in original language and translated) 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable
  • Two references with contact details 
  • Documented pedagogical competence. Brief description of teaching philosophy/documentation of educational competence in the form of a pedagogical map or course certificate of completed university pedagogical basic competence such as UNIPED 100 at UiT or equivalent from other universities 
  • A list of your academic production 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important 
  • Academic works, up to ten. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Documentation of English proficiency.  

Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 

  • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
  • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
  • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
  • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
  • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 

Documentation has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position.

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilizeour location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.
 

UiT has approximately18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta ,Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT'sactivities. Participation, co-determination,
transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous -closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments

See: UiTs strategi mot 2030

jobs.description:
ETSIMME OULUN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON VIIKONLOPPUIHIN

Kotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Etsimme nyt Oulun alueelle lähihoitajaa tai loppuvaiheen opiskelijaa kotihoitoon osa-aikaiseen työhön. Pääset aloittamaan työn heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn, hyvinvoinnin ja turvallisuuden tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä omalla tavallasi, asiakasta kunnioittaen

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana.

Nähdään Alinassa!

----------------------------------------

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 30 eri puolilla Suomea. Yhdeksän kymmenestä asiakkaastamme suosittelisi Alinaa tuttavilleen, ja työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. jobs.description:
Who we are looking for

We're looking for a Founding Growth Marketer to build Birdsview's growth engine from the ground up, the person who turns "we have a great product" into a steady flow of qualified pipeline. AI first person.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding Growth Marketer, you will be the engine of our international growth. The role is hands-on: you'll use AI tools to build and test campaigns across channels, turn technical value into content that resonates with engineers and asset owners, run experiments to find what actually converts, and hand qualified leads to our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly formed marketing function, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the engine
    You'll design and implement our full growth marketing engine, taking a foundational role in shaping our strategy.

  • Own demand generation
    Own demand generation across content, paid, and organic channels, directly impacting qualified lead flow to sales. You're measured on qualified leads reaching sales.

  • Find the message that lands
    Test positioning against our different customer segments; engineers, contractors, asset owners and find the one we can scale. Nobody has the answer yet.

  • Work the funnel with sales
    Hand qualified leads to our sales team, and use what they hear back to sharpen the next campaign.

  • Build the measurement
    Set up tracking, reporting, and analytics to measure performance, identify effective strategies, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Make the technical obvious
    Leverage AI tools to create and test innovative campaigns that translate complex technical value into resonant messages for our target audience.

What we're looking for

  • AI-first, systematic and test-driven. You run experiments, read the data, and a campaign that flops doesn't slow you down.

  • Proven ability to build and run a complete growth engine: lead generation, content, paid campaigns, organic channels.

  • Skills in setting up tracking, reporting and analytics, so performance is measured rather than asserted.

  • Experience developing, testing and refining positioning and messaging, in collaboration with sales and leadership.

  • 1–3 years of experience in B2B growth or marketing, ideally in a startup or scale-up. Hands-on and results-oriented, this is a building role.

  • Fluent English; Norwegian is an advantage.

  • Based in Bergen or Oslo, or willing to relocate.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary and equity - become an owner.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

View the full details for the job here.

jobs.title: Associate professor of Equine Sports Medicine
jobs.description:
Associate professor of Equine Sports Medicine

Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences

Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences

University of Copenhagen



The University seeks to appoint an associate professor within Equine Sports Medicine to the Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences to commence 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the Department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/ and www.ikv.ku.dk/english.

About us

The Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences covers strong and internationally recognized research areas in clinical veterinary sciences. A relatively large part of our research is fertilised and inspired from clinical challenges, identified in the hospital, in our ambulatory field practice or from our external collaborators. Based on these, we want to set a new standard for cross-disciplinary research, education and innovation within animal health and disease.

The Section for Medicine, Surgery and Reproduction for Large animals holds research and clinical teaching, in a modern 24-hour open university veterinary teaching hospital and ambulatory field practice service for all large animals with horses as the primary species consulted. We also have the cross departmental, University of Copenhagen Centre for Veterinary Simulation, which is open 24/7 for veterinary students to practice clinical skills. Our research is focused on diseases of clinical relevance for horses and cattle thereby having a direct application for veterinarians and animal owners. Also, translational research bridging basic science to companion animal as well as human medicine is a strength of the section.

We have a strong educational and scientific focus on the athletic horse collaborating with internationally recognised research groups within cardiovascular, airway and orthopaedic research with a high impact translational research profile. To fully exploit the scientific and clinical potentials, the muscular development and disease understanding in sports and rehabilitation medicine both in horses and companion animals and is a strategic research area in the department, why collaboration with the companion animal sections of the department is expected in the position. The announced associate professorship is crucial to enhancing and strengthening this area to fully obtain the synergy of the other research areas mentioned above.

Equine medicine is a core discipline in the fourth and fifth years of the veterinary medical education in Denmark. Therefore the position is highly involved in research based teaching of veterinary students within equine sports medicine and the candidate is expected to take a leadership role in conducting clinical relevant research, teaching and examining undergraduate students, as well as assist and promote the development of both pre-and postgraduate teaching as well as research strategies within the field of equine sports medicine.

The culture of the department is typical Scandinavian: a flat structure with a tradition for close collaboration where all employees are expecting openness, mutual respect, and sharing of ideas, resources and competences.

Job description

In considering applications for the associate professorship, the main emphasis will be on the following aspects:

  • The applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific production at an international level within the area of equine sports medicine and preferably with a strong translational profile.
  • The applicant’s practical experience within equine general medicine in both a hospital and in research setting.
  • The applicants experience with development of clinical research-based teaching of veterinary students.
The associate professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • Research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • Research-based pre-and postgraduate teaching, including clinical teaching and service, associated examination and course responsibilities
  • Strengthen, developing and integrating muscular research in research-based teaching of veterinary students
  • Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers and veterinary students as well as securing external funding.
  • Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate and engagement in topics of relevance for horse owners
  • Organizational contribution to the section, department and university incl. e.g. participation in department committees and course leadership.
  • Academic assessments
Required qualifications

To be qualified for an associate professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership.

Find information about each criterion.

The successful applicant should:

  • Hold a DVM with license to practice in Denmark or be willing to apply for such within 6 months.
  • Hold a PhD degree or similar qualifications.
  • Diplomat degree within ECEIM, ACVIM or ECVSMR is an advantage.
  • Document a high degree of research experience and scientific publications within the field of equine internal medicine and sports medicine at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline.
  • Have experience with research management and other management functions, including attraction of external funding and group leadership.
  • Document pre-and postgraduate clinical teaching experience within the field of the position and documented pedagogical training at university level.
  • Perform research-based teaching.
  • Perform quality patient care and service management in an equine hospital and ambulatory field practice within equine general medicine.
  • Possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.
  • If Danish is not the first language, the applicant is expected to obtain sufficient Danish skills within 1-2 years.
Diversity and International Applicants

The University of Copenhagen is committed to fostering diversity and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.

Useful resources:

  • www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility)
  • www.workingconditions.ku.dk.
Terms of employment

The position is a permanent position.

The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

Employment is as associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers here

Questions

For further information, please contact group leader Tina Holberg Pihl thpi@sund.ku.dk.

Application

The application must be submitted in English, by clicking on "Apply online" below, and must include the following:

  • Application, including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Diplomas - (Master’s, PhD, and other relevant certificates)
  • Upload a list of maximum 5 publications to be assessed
  • Research plan (3-5 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Teaching portfolio (Guidelines)
The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's job portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Please submit the application with the required attachments.

The closing date for applications is 29 October 2026 23.59 p.m. CET.

Employer: Department of Veterinary Clinical and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Homepage: http://ikvh.ku.dk/english/

The University of Copenhagen actively influences current and future generations through excellent research, education and co-operation. UCPH is one of the highest ranked universities in Europe and is Denmark´s oldest university, founded in 1479. Today, the University has 37,000 students and

9,000 employees affiliated across six faculties: humanities, law, natural sciences, social sciences, health sciences and theology www.ku.dk/english.

jobs.description:
Primary location:
RAASEPORI

APULAISPÄÄLLIKKÖ, S-MARKET TAMMISAARI, 37,5H, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme S-market Tammisaareen kokoaikaista apulaispäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tämä työ sopii sinulle, joka nautit vaihtelevasta arjesta, pidät ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja haluat olla mukana tekemässä isosta ja monipuolisesta myymälästä paikkaa, jossa on kiva asioida ja tehdä töitä. S-market Tammisaaren arki tarjoaa paljon erilaisia toimintoja, tilanteita ja mahdollisuuksia onnistua yhdessä tiimin kanssa.
Apulaispäällikkönä, eli tuttavallisemmin apparina, olet toimipaikkapäällikön tärkein työpari ja mukana varmistamassa, että myymälän arki rullaa sujuvasti aamusta iltaan. Isossa yksikössä pääset näkemään kaupan arkea laajasti ja saat kivasti vastuuta sekä hyvän mahdollisuuden kasvaa esihenkilönä konkreettisen tekemisen kautta.

Tässä tehtävässä:
- Vastaat yhdessä toimipaikkapäällikön kanssa asiakastyytyväisyydestä, palvelusta, prosesseista, henkilökunnan työnohjauksesta ja myymälän operatiivisesta tuloksesta.
- Johdat toimintaa omalla esimerkilläsi ja olet arjessa mukana niin hyllytyksessä, kassalla kuin asiakaspalvelussa.
- Sparraat toimipaikkapäällikköä ja tuet henkilökuntaa, sillä tiimityö on avain kaikkeen, mitä teemme.
- Työskentelet vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa, jotta myymälä on parhaassa mahdollisessa kunnossa kaikkina aukioloaikoina.
- Hyppäät vastuuseen itsenäisesti toimipaikkapäällikön lomien aikana.
Onnistuaksesi tehtävässä:
- Olet oma-aloitteinen, järjestelmällinen ja tykkäät siitä, että työpäivässä tapahtuu.
- Sinulla on jo kokemusta kaupan alalta – mielellään myös vastuutehtävistä.
- Osaat toimia paineisissakin tilanteissa hymyssä suin.
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Valmentava ote ja hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ovat osa sinua.
- On tärkeää, että kykenet asiakaspalveluun vähintään suomeksi tai ruotsiksi.
Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua jatkuvasti, esimerkiksi erilaisten koulutusten sekä ammatillisen tutkinnon tai sen osan suorittamisen kautta.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.
Palkkaus

- Apulaispäälliköille maksetaan lisäksi tehtävän vaativuuden mukaista vastuulisää.
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
